Deck 2 now plays in Bbm, and ORIGINAL shows Am The key readout and Key Sync are explained in The play screen and Beat jump and performance features .

manual:f9efc2e65ba1c8f816a6.source: KEY MATCH COLOURS colours keys green or amber by how well they mix with the master deck, in the track list and on the play screen. Green means the key mixes with the master's key and sits within 25 cents of it. Amber means it would mix, but it is detuned by more than 25 cents. KEY BEFORE TITLE puts the key in front of each title in the track list. See Browsing and loading .

manual:9463fa6ec1b4f0afe634.source: When a screen names a deck, it draws the deck number in a small badge. The badge tells you the deck by its digit and the pair by its colours. Decks Badge 1 and 2 White digit on grey 3 and 4 Black digit on white A deck that is not live The same badge, dimmed No deck owns a colour. Blue and pale blue mark the deck a side of the player controls. Amber, red, green, the waveform bands and USB colours keep their own meanings. The WORKS ON row in the MODS dock uses the same badges, in mixer order 3 1 2 4 . See Four decks for the deck view.

manual:9a4da33247ba79fcfb3b.source: SYSTEM READOUT puts CPU load, memory and temperature beside STEMS and MODS on the top bar. Open it to see deck 3 and 4 audio render times and active key shifters across all four decks. P99 is the time at or below which 99% of the last 256 rendered blocks finished; MAX is the longest. Short blocks are scaled to a full block. D3+D4 MAX adds both maxima and compares them with the 5,805 microseconds available per block. New shifts use a stricter 3,483 microsecond budget, leaving time for other work. These render numbers include decoding, time stretch and key shift; they do not measure the complete output path. Use them when you suspect the player is working hard, for example with stems on both decks and four decks running. Press MENU Tap SCREEN Tap SYSTEM READOUT Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise The first setup step with live readings and four key shifters engaged. STEP Where you are in the setup. What the numbers mean CPU 100% means all four cores are busy. RAM leaves out cache. 80 C turns yellow, 90 C flashes red with HOT. Audio render time Each software deck shows its p99 and maximum render time in microseconds. LAST RUN means the reading is no longer live. Key shifters Counts shifted decks, including decks 1 and 2. The combined software maximum is shown against one audio block. DETECT METRICS Runs the current step. Push to move through the setup. Choose SYSTEM READOUT on the SCREEN page. Push DETECT METRICS . The setup looks for CPU, memory and the temperature sensor. Follow the remaining steps until the live readings show. After setup the row on the SCREEN page reads ON . On the top bar, METRICS STARTING - TAP TO SET UP means the readings have not arrived yet. METRICS STALE - TAP TO VERIFY means they stopped updating. Tap either one to open the setup again. Note Only the temperature of the main chip is available on the XDJ-XZ.

manual:c690e31b5eec2c76eefb.source: Press MENU Tap SCREEN Tap CLASSIC Tap MODERN Tap 3-BAND COLOURS Tap STANDARD Tap BLUE Tap RED Tap GREEN Tap AMBER Tap PURPLE Tap CYAN Tap PINK Tap WHITE Tap STANDARD Tap BLUE Tap RED Tap GREEN Tap AMBER Tap PURPLE Tap CYAN Tap PINK Tap WHITE Tap STANDARD Tap BLUE Tap RED Tap GREEN Tap AMBER Tap PURPLE Tap CYAN Tap PINK Tap WHITE Tap RESET 3-BAND COLOURS Tap RESET 3-BAND COLOURS Press BACK Press MENU What you see What to do The theme did not change Close MODS. The play screen takes the new theme once MODS is closed DECK VIEW is missing from SCREEN This player's USB loader cannot run decks 3 and 4. See Four decks STEMS waveforms look like 3-BAND The track has no prepared stems, or it has four stems. See Stems Keys show in the wrong notation Set KEY NOTATION. AS ON THE USB follows your library's own setting The waveform colours are not the ones you expect Check 3-BAND COLOURS. RESET 3-BAND COLOURS puts every band back to STANDARD

manual:ee5f2f849d31b7587f2b.source: CONNECT is the MODS section for people and computers: your DJ profile, the VJ.Tools link, the player's network and updates over the network. Everything here is optional. The player plays the same with all of it switched off. Open MODS with MENU , then choose CONNECT in the section rail.

manual:aafa1e234db1a653a2f7.source: Press MENU Tap CONNECT Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 3 clicks clockwise Press BACK The four parts of CONNECT. The highlighted card is explained in the dock. DJ PROFILE Your DJ name and logo from the USB, for VJ screens. VJ.TOOLS The optional link to VJ.Tools on a computer, and the VJ.Tools screen view. NETWORK The player's network adapters and addresses. UPDATES Signed XZ Mods updates over the network. An update starts at the next power cycle. Dock Explains the highlighted card before you open it. The HOME card for CONNECT shows your active DJ profile and its USB, then the state of the VJ.Tools link, for example DJ Kai (USB 1) | VJ.Tools waiting . With no profile it reads No DJ profile .

manual:b0b48e10c54e6f78991a.source: A DJ profile is your DJ name and logo, with an optional tagline. It lives on your USB, next to your music. VJ software such as VJ.Tools shows the profile of the USB that is playing on the master deck, so the screens behind you show who is playing. Nothing is stored on the XZ and nothing is uploaded. Press MENU Tap CONNECT Tap DJ PROFILE Tap SET UP DJ PROFILE Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise DJ Profile is an open standard. Any player, mixer or VJ program can read the same folder.

manual:c6591fa9d937dff0602d.source: Press MENU Tap CONNECT Tap DJ PROFILE Tap SET UP DJ PROFILE Tap CHECK USB FOR PROFILES Press BACK On the USB, make a folder named DJPROFILE at the top level. Inside it, make a folder with your DJ name, for example DJPROFILE/DJ Kai . Put your logo in that folder as logo.png or logo.jpg . Put the USB in the XZ, open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE and push CHECK USB FOR PROFILES . A folder with a usable logo is a profile. A folder without one is skipped. A USB shows at most 16 profiles. The XZ Mods app can also make and edit profiles. See The XZ Mods app .

manual:9f2feb599bebd78f1d83.source: You can type a profile on the player with the encoder or by touch. Press MENU Tap CONNECT Tap DJ PROFILE Tap SET UP DJ PROFILE Tap CREATE ON THIS XZ Type dj test on the screen keyboard Tap NEXT: LOGO Tap NO LOGO Tap NEXT: TAGLINE Type fixture set on the screen keyboard Tap NEXT: REVIEW Tap SAVE TO USB 1 Tap NEW PROFILE Type dj two on the screen keyboard Tap NEXT: LOGO Tap NO LOGO Tap NEXT: TAGLINE Tap SKIP TAGLINE Tap SAVE TO USB 1 Tap

manual:20c2c0d610472848b864.source: PREV Tap MAKE ACTIVE Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE . Push CREATE ON THIS XZ , or NEW PROFILE if the USB already has one. Type your DJ name on the on-screen keyboard, then push NEXT: LOGO . Pick a PNG or JPEG image from the USB, or NO LOGO . Images in your own DJPROFILE folder are listed first. Then push NEXT: TAGLINE . Type a few words, such as your genre, city or crew, and push NEXT: REVIEW . To leave the tagline out, push SKIP TAGLINE . Check the review, then push SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 . A new profile becomes the active profile on the USB you save it to. Only the DJPROFILE folder on that USB is written. Your music, playlists and stems are not touched. Step Controls Name and tagline The keyboard, SHIFT for capitals, #+= for symbols ( ABC goes back), SPACE , DELETE , BACK to the step before Logo One row per image on the USB, PREV and NEXT for more, RESCAN (or CHECK USB AGAIN ), NO LOGO , KEEP CURRENT when you edit Review CHANGE NAME , CHANGE LOGO , CHANGE TAGLINE , then SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2 A name holds up to 64 characters and a tagline up to 80. With NO LOGO , your initial is shown on the accent colour. Logos are shown square over black. Nothing is saved until you push SAVE. The bottom line says NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE on the review step.

manual:e033fb00f5bcf966b2c3.source: With profiles on the USB, the DJ PROFILE page shows one profile at a time: its logo, name and tagline, which USB it is on, and whether it is active there. Control or line What it means

manual:086e326b6e5d41258b81.source: PREV , NEXT > Step through the profiles on both USBs. 2 OF 3 shows where you are EDIT Change this profile's name, logo or tagline MAKE ACTIVE Makes this the active profile on its USB. Only the USB is written NEW PROFILE Makes another profile on the USB, for an alias or a back to back set CHECK USB Reads both USB ports again ACTIVE ON THIS USB This profile is the one its USB says is playing SHOWN TO THE VJ NOW This is the profile VJ software sees right now FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILE A profile made from a folder and a logo OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLS An older profile card. Edit it in VJ.Tools, or make a new profile Your active profile also sits in the MODS header, with its logo and name. Tap it, or highlight it and push, to switch between the profiles on both USBs. Note The player's own saved settings are MY SETTINGS in UTILITY. They are separate from your DJ profile.

manual:9247542f436732785ab5.source: Press MENU Tap CONNECT Tap DJ PROFILE Tap SET UP DJ PROFILE Tap CREATE ON THIS XZ Type dj test on the screen keyboard Tap NEXT: LOGO Tap pictures/alternate.jpg Tap NEXT: TAGLINE Tap SKIP TAGLINE Tap SAVE TO USB 1 Tap CHANGE LOGO Tap NO LOGO Tap NEXT: TAGLINE Tap SKIP TAGLINE Tap SAVE TO USB 1 Message What to do INSERT THE USB WITH YOUR MUSIC Put your USB in. Profiles live on the USB only NO DJ PROFILE ON THIS USB YET Make one on a computer or on the XZ, as above INSERT A USB FIRST Insert a USB before you push CREATE ON THIS XZ TYPE YOUR DJ NAME FIRST The name cannot be empty THE NAME IS FULL, THE TAGLINE IS FULL You reached 64 or 80 characters THAT USB IS NOT IN / PUT IT BACK Put the USB back in the port you are saving to THIS LOGO CANNOT BE USED / CHANGE LOGO Pick another image, or NO LOGO THIS PROFILE FILE IS DAMAGED / SAVE IT AGAIN FROM VJ.TOOLS Save the profile again from VJ.Tools or the XZ Mods app SAVING YOUR PROFILE TO THE USB / KEEP THE USB IN Wait. Do not pull the USB

manual:8aaeadf647fc05487dd1.source: VJ.Tools is a desktop app for VJs. The VJ.TOOLS page lets VJ.Tools on a computer connect to the player, announces the player on the network, and can show the computer's picture instead of the play screen. Press MENU Tap CONNECT Tap VJ.TOOLS Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise VJ.Tools connected and sending frames. The player still shows its own play screen. STATUS CONNECTED, WAITING FOR VJ.TOOLS, DISABLED or NOT AVAILABLE. DEVICE IP The player's address for VJ.Tools. PORT The port VJ.Tools connects to. PROTOCOL What the link carries. You only need it when you report a problem. RECEIVED FPS Frames per second arriving from VJ.Tools. NOT REPORTED until frames arrive. Screen in use NATIVE PLAY SCREEN ACTIVE, or COMPUTER SCREEN ACTIVE while the VJ.Tools view is on. VJ.TOOLS VIEW Shows the computer's VJ.Tools screen instead of the player screen. SCREEN SWITCH KEY What switches the VJ.Tools view while you play: LINK or an ONSCREEN button. VJ.TOOLS CONNECTION Lets VJ.Tools on a computer connect to this player. DISCOVERABLE Announces this player so VJ.Tools finds it on the network. vj.tools Where to get VJ.Tools. Control Choices What it does Waiting for VJ.Tools. The link controls are read only on this player Waiting for VJ.Tools. The link controls are read only on this player VJ.TOOLS VIEW ON, OFF ON shows the computer's VJ.Tools screen on the player. OFF shows the play screen SCREEN SWITCH KEY LINK, ONSCREEN LINK makes the LINK key switch the view. ONSCREEN puts a button for it on the screen. See Controls on the player VJ.TOOLS CONNECTION ON, OFF Lets VJ.Tools connect DISCOVERABLE ON, OFF Lets VJ.Tools find the player without typing its address When a link control shows READ ONLY , MODS cannot change it on this player. Pushing it shows CONTROL IS NOT AVAILABLE . To switch the view without opening MODS, use the key you chose under SCREEN SWITCH KEY. You can also give the button above LINK the job VJ.TOOLS SCREEN in PLAY › BUTTON ABOVE LINK . It needs an enabled, connected VJ.Tools link, and says so when there is none. In CLASSIC, a VJ.TOOLS button can appear on the top bar. It reads EXIT VJ while the view is on. Experimental The VJ.Tools view has shown video on the player during development. Long playback and touch while the view is on have not been accepted yet. Keep it off during a set unless you have tested it.

manual:2c6cc87fc33521dcd194.source: NETWORK sets up the player's network adapters for VJ.Tools and network updates. You do not need it to play. Press MENU Tap CONNECT Tap NETWORK Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise The NETWORK page before the adapters have been read. Status line What the page knows now. CHANGES LAST UNTIL REBOOT reminds you that nothing here is permanent. What is known Which parts the player reports, and that nothing changes until you apply. SET UP NETWORK Starts the setup: read the adapters, choose, review, apply. DETECT ADAPTERS AGAIN Reads the adapters again, for example after you plug in a cable. NETWORK UPDATES Opens UPDATES. NETWORK SETUP before the adapters have been read NETWORK SETUP before the adapters have been read Setup runs in four steps. Every change lasts until the player is switched off. Detect. The page lists each adapter with its link state and current address. Choose. Pick an adapter and how it gets an address: KEEP CURRENT , DHCP ON or STATIC IP . With STATIC IP, use EDIT IP , EDIT MASK / PREFIX and EDIT GATEWAY . PRIORITY UP and PRIORITY DOWN set which adapter XZ Mods prefers. Review. Push REVIEW CHANGES and read the summary. Apply. Push APPLY FOR THIS BOOT . The page then checks the result. REVERT TRIAL / MODS DHCP OFF undoes what this setup added. The keypad for an address, mask or gateway. Field Which value you are typing and what you have typed. Digits and point Type the address one character at a time. BACKSPACE Deletes the last character. CLEAR Empties the field. DONE Keeps the value and goes back to the setup. CANCEL Leaves the value as it was. Message What to do DETECT ACTUAL ADAPTERS FIRST Push DETECT ADAPTERS AGAIN, then choose ENTER A VALID IP AND CONTIGUOUS MASK / PREFIX Check the address and mask you typed ENTER A VALID GATEWAY OR KEEP ROUTE OFF Type a valid gateway, or set MODS ROUTE: OFF NETWORK CHANGED / DETECT AND CHOOSE AGAIN A cable or adapter changed. Start the setup again RELOAD A PRIVATE USB IMAGE WITH NETWORK SUPPORT This USB loader has no network support. Update the loader with the XZ Mods app, then push VERIFY RELOADED LOADER Experimental The NETWORK pages still use technical wording and may change. Your changes never outlive a power cycle, so switching the player off and on always brings back its own network setup.

manual:2d5d9ee87bd547322b73.source: UPDATES fetches a newer signed XZ Mods runtime from the XZ Mods app on your computer and saves it to the USB. The update starts at the next power cycle. Your music stays where it is. Press MENU Tap CONNECT Tap UPDATES Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise UPDATES before the update server has been found. What it does Downloads a signed runtime to the USB. Power cycle to activate. Recovery Updates change XZ Mods only. The original USB loader is the way back. SET UP NETWORK UPDATES Opens UPDATE SETUP, which finds the update server. DOWNLOAD UPDATE Downloads the update to the USB. It activates after a power cycle. PREVIOUS VERSION Goes back to the previous XZ Mods version at the next power cycle. REPORT AN ISSUE Opens REPORT AN ISSUE in EXTRAS. NETWORK SETUP Opens NETWORK. The three things the player needs before it can update over the network. Steps Use the updated USB loader, start network updates in the desktop app, connect the XZ to that network. DETECT UPDATE SERVER Asks the update server for a newer signed runtime. BACK TO UPDATES Returns to UPDATES. Prepare the USB with a current XZ Mods app, so the loader supports network updates. In the XZ Mods app, start network updates. See The XZ Mods app . Connect the XZ to the same network as the computer. Use NETWORK if it needs an address. Open CONNECT › UPDATES › SET UP NETWORK UPDATES and push DETECT UPDATE SERVER . Back on UPDATES, push DOWNLOAD UPDATE . Switch the player off and on to start the new version. Caution Never switch the player off while the update is being written to the USB, and never update during a set. To undo an update, push PREVIOUS VERSION and switch the player off and on. Network updates change XZ Mods only. If the player will not start XZ Mods at all, restore or update the USB loader with the XZ Mods app.

manual:ccab35b2c531251e3352.source: EXTRAS holds what is not about playing a set: games, apps from a USB, reporting a problem and the About page. Nothing here starts on its own. The XZ always starts in its normal DJ view, and a game or app opens only when you choose it. Open MODS with MENU , then choose EXTRAS in the section rail.

manual:27a3de10d84e70ecbe50.source: Press MENU Tap EXTRAS Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 3 clicks clockwise Press BACK The four parts of EXTRAS. GAMES Doom and Chex Quest, Beat Arcade, Wave Rider, Rhythm Lab and Static Surfer. USB APPS XZ SDK apps from a USB. REPORT AN ISSUE Send a problem, a question or an idea from the player. ABOUT XZ MODS Credits, links and support. Dock Explains the highlighted card. For GAMES it reminds you that audio keeps playing. The HOME card for EXTRAS counts the games and the apps found on your USBs, for example 6 games | no USB apps .

manual:462bef9964f8a6828059.source: Every game runs on the XZ itself. The music keeps playing while you play, and PLAY and track search keep their normal jobs in Beat Arcade. Doom and Beat Arcade make no sound of their own. Press MENU Tap EXTRAS Tap GAMES Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise Every game, plus USB WAD LOADER and MY HOUSE / SETUP. DOOM / CHOOSE WAD Classic Doom or Doom II. Choose the game files next. CHEX QUEST The original Chex Quest with its patch. BEAT ARCADE Pong and Breakout scored on the beat, played with the jog. WAVE RIDER Surf the playing track's waveform with the jog. USB WAD LOADER Choose a Doom base game and an optional add-on from the USB. MY HOUSE / SETUP Checks for the engine the My House mod needs. RHYTHM LAB / 10 STUDIES Ten short rhythm studies played on the pads. STATIC SURFER A runner game set to the playing track. Game What it is Needs Beat Arcade experimental Solo Pong, Pong Duel on both jogs, Solo Breaks and a two-player Breakout. Tap CUE on the beat to build charge Nothing. Built in Wave Rider experimental The loaded track's waveform becomes hills. Steer with the jog, hold CUE to add weight. Solo, Co-op or Versus Nothing. Built in Rhythm Lab Ten short rhythm studies for the jogs and pads. They are prototypes, and you can rate each one Nothing. Built in Static Surfer A rhythm platformer. Tap to jump and tilt the jog to pass through the glyphs Nothing. Built in Doom Classic Doom or Doom II Game files on the USB Chex Quest The original Chex Quest Game files on the USB

manual:554b6db833f2d005adc4.source: You do not need the touchscreen in any game. Press MENU Tap EXTRAS Tap GAMES Tap WAVE RIDER Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise, then push it Push ROTARY SELECTOR Push ROTARY SELECTOR Turn the left jog wheel Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise, then push it Press CUE on the left deck Turn the left jog wheel Tap the screen Control In a game Turn the encoder Moves a ring over the controls on the screen Push the encoder Presses the control under the ring BACK Steps back Touch Presses what you touch. The ring hides until you turn the encoder again

manual:9a91ffb41c468a1f6b58.source: Turn the jog to move your paddle and tap CUE on each beat as the moving light meets the target. Good notes build charge. Eight good notes in a row earn a shield, and sixteen build a Drop that fires on the next downbeat. Press MENU Tap EXTRAS Tap GAMES Tap BEAT ARCADE Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise, then push it Turn the left jog wheel Press CUE on the left deck Press pad G on the left deck Tap the screen Tap the screen Control Action Jog Moves the paddle. In the menu, chooses a game CUE or pad A Strikes on the beat. Starts, resumes and rematches Pad B Wide paddle for 16 beats Pad C Saves one miss with a shield Pad D Queues a Drop on the next downbeat Pads E and F Aim the next return Pad G Changes the scene between Tunnel, Grid and Orbit Pad H Lines up with the mixer tempo, or taps a tempo PLAY, track search Work as usual on the music DJ VIEW on screen Saves the round and gives every control back to the deck Tap the source display at the top of the game to choose where the beat comes from: an analysed USB track, Pro DJ Link, the mixer tempo or four taps on pad H. For mixer tempo, set Beat FX to the channel you play, usually MASTER, and use AUTO BPM. While Beat Arcade runs, touching the platter does not pause or scratch the music. Choose DJ VIEW before you go back to mixing.

manual:db9a2fc8eec06c8b6349.source: Choose Solo , Co-op or Versus , then the deck whose track you ride. In Solo that deck's jog steers. With two players, the left jog is player 1 and the right jog is player 2. Hold CUE or a top-row pad to add weight and gain speed downhill. Let go as the ground rises, and the crest throws you into the air. Turn the jog to tilt the board. Clockwise points the nose down. Land with the slope to keep your speed. Clean landings in a row score more. EASY is the default and keeps the angle you set in the air. NORMAL and HARD are stricter. A missed landing never stops the music.

manual:46743e95e41db9427f77.source: Doom and Chex Quest need game files on the USB. The XZ Mods app can download and check free Doom shareware, Chex Quest and Freedoom data when you prepare the USB. For the full Doom or Doom II you supply your own files. See The XZ Mods app . Press MENU Tap EXTRAS Tap GAMES Tap USB WAD LOADER Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise The Doom page before its game files have been checked. Status USB GAME SETUP NEEDED until the files and engine have been checked. Controls What each control does while the game is open. Notes The buttons belong to the game while it is open. Exit gives back the DJ screen. Game sound is off. SET UP DOOM Reads START DOOM once setup is done. Starts the game full screen. DJ audio keeps playing. USB WADS Opens USB WAD LOADER to choose the game files. Player control In Doom Jog Turn left or right PLAY, or pad A Walk forward Pad B Walk back CUE, or pad C Shoot Pad D Use, for example open a door Pads E and F Strafe Pad G Enter Pad H, or BACK Game menu Turn and push the encoder Moves through the game menu and enters To end the game, touch EXIT . The player goes back to the screen you had before. The three setup steps for Doom. Steps Find the Doom engine on the USB loader, choose a base game and optional map, then start Doom to check. Where the files go A WADS or VJTOOLS/DOOM folder on the USB. The XZ Mods app Prepares a Doom USB for you. CHOOSE USB GAME FILES Opens USB WAD LOADER. BACK TO DOOM Returns to the Doom page. The loader with no game files found yet. File list One row per game file on the USB. Choose the base game, then an add-on if you want one. PREV and NEXT Pages through a long list. RESCAN USB Searches both USB ports again. NO ADD-ON Plays the base game with no add-on. SETUP Opens GAME SETUP. If the list says PUT .WAD FILES ON USB, THEN RESCAN , copy the files to the USB on a computer, put it back and push RESCAN USB .

manual:e504dd55d54112c509e7.source: My House is a Doom mod that needs the GZDoom engine. The MY HOUSE page checks for that engine and the files, but the classic Doom engine cannot load this mod, and the XZ Mods app no longer copies it to the USB. Press MENU Tap EXTRAS Tap GAMES Tap MY HOUSE / SETUP Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise The My House check. Steps Find the GZDoom engine, choose the Doom II data and MYHOUSE.PK3, check and start. Limit The classic Doom engine cannot load this mod. CHECK ENGINE Checks the engine and My House files on the USB. BACK TO GAMES Returns to GAMES.

manual:663125724994f994be51.source: USB APPS runs apps built with the XZ SDK from a USB. DJ controls keep working while an app runs. Press MENU Tap EXTRAS Tap USB APPS Tap SET UP APPS Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise USB APPS while the app manager is not running. AUTOLOAD ON starts apps in the autoload folder when their USB goes in. OFF starts apps only when you run them. Status How many packages were found, or why there are none. Message The one thing to do next. PREV and NEXT Pages through the apps. RESCAN USB Searches the USB again for apps. SET UP APPS A four-step guide from finding apps to a live test. Put apps on a USB in VJ.Tools/XZ-SDK/Applications . Apps in VJ.Tools/XZ-SDK/Autoload start on their own when AUTOLOAD is on. Each app row shows what kind of package it is and its state. State Meaning RUNNING ON SCREEN An app is showing on the player RUNNING IN BACKGROUND A service is running APPLIED A profile package is in use FAILED The app stopped. Push RUN AGAIN BLOCKED The package cannot run. Push SET UP to see how to fix it CHECKING The app manager is still reading the package Step 1 of SET UP APPS, with the app manager not running. Step Which of the four steps you are on. Step tabs DETECT, FOLDERS, INSTALL, LIVE TEST. Tap one to jump to it. Result What this step found. What to do The one action that fixes it. CHECK AGAIN Runs this step again. BACK TO APPS Returns to USB APPS. Detect. Finds the app manager and any apps on the USB. Folders. Choose START WHEN I TAP RUN or START ON USB INSERT . Install. Copy apps to the USB. The page shows the packer command for the desktop. Live test. Push RUN TEST APP . When it shows, push IT WORKS . Note APP MANAGER NOT RUNNING means XZ Mods did not start it. Switch the XZ off, start it again with its XZ Mods USB in, then push CHECK AGAIN .

manual:0446f98efcee58272950.source: REPORT AN ISSUE sends the maintainer a problem, a question or an idea from the player. You say what it is about and, if you like, what happened. The player adds its own details. A topic and SEND take three presses. Press MENU Tap EXTRAS Tap REPORT AN ISSUE Turn ROTARY SELECTOR to SOMETHING ISN'T WORKING and push it Push ROTARY SELECTOR to choose SKIP, I'LL ADD IT ON MY COMPUTER What's this about? Push one of the five topics, or NOT SURE . What happened? Type a few words, or push SKIP, I'LL ADD IT ON MY COMPUTER . Ready to send. Check the summary, then push SEND REPORT . With the encoder, push three times: the first topic, SKIP, then SEND. Step 1: what the report is about. WHAT'S THIS ABOUT? One question. Each topic goes straight to the next step. Topics SOMETHING GOT WORSE, SOMETHING ISN'T WORKING, IT SHOULD WORK DIFFERENTLY, I HAVE A NEW IDEA and HOW DO I...? NOT SURE Skips the question. The report still goes. Steps Where you are: step 1 of 3. Step 2, before you type. SKIP is lit: one push goes on without words. OPTIONAL You can send a report without typing anything. Your words Up to 280 characters. The count is on the right. Keyboard Turn and push the encoder, or tap the keys. The first letter is a capital. SKIP, I'LL ADD IT ON MY COMPUTER Goes on without words. Your computer asks what happened later. NEXT Goes on with what you typed. Once you type, NEXT is lit instead. WHAT HAPPENED? with words typed: NEXT is lit WHAT HAPPENED? with words typed: NEXT is lit Step 3: what will be sent. ABOUT The topic you chose. WHAT HAPPENED Your words, or a note that you add them on your computer. ALSO INCLUDED Added by the player: the XZ Mods version, your settings, this stick's loader ID, the recent USB diary and the screen you were on. No music, track names or file names. IT GOES TO The XZ Mods inbox when the player is online, otherwise this stick. CHANGE Goes back to that step. Your words are kept. SEND REPORT Sends it. BACK goes back a step. If you leave the page before sending, your words wait for you there.

manual:09fa8033fcc32b337136.source: The report goes one of three ways. Whichever it is, nothing is lost and you never type it again. Press MENU Tap EXTRAS Tap REPORT AN ISSUE Turn ROTARY SELECTOR to SOMETHING ISN'T WORKING and push it Type test report on the screen keyboard Tap NEXT Tap SEND REPORT Tap EDIT REPORT Tap CHANGE Tap HOW DO I...? Tap NEXT Tap SEND REPORT Tap DONE The screen says What happened What to do SENT and a reference like R-4F7K-2M9Q It reached the XZ Mods inbox Finish it on your computer: the XZ Mods app reminds you and shows the same reference SAVED ON THIS STICK The player is offline, its clock is not set, the loader is from an older XZ Mods app, or the inbox did not take it Plug the stick into your computer. The XZ Mods app opens the report NOT SENT YET It could not be sent, and the stick could not take it Do what the line says (put the stick back, use a writable stick, make room on it), then push TRY AGAIN SENT: the reference to look for in the XZ Mods app SAVED ON THIS STICK NOT SENT YET: the reason, TRY AGAIN and EDIT REPORT While it sends. You can keep playing and close MODS SENT: the reference to look for in the XZ Mods app SAVED ON THIS STICK NOT SENT YET: the reason, TRY AGAIN and EDIT REPORT While it sends. You can keep playing and close MODS A saved report waits in VJ.Tools/XZ-Mods-reports/pending/ on the stick, up to 32 of them. The XZ Mods app sends it from there and moves it to sent/ . TRY AGAIN sends the same report, so the maintainer gets it once.

manual:9701aa8a340e533f8f8e.source: When an error shows in the dock's top row, REPORT THIS beside it opens REPORT AN ISSUE at WHAT HAPPENED? with SOMETHING ISN'T WORKING chosen. Push SKIP and SEND REPORT , and the error goes with it. Every report includes an error on screen, however you open it. Press MENU Tap REPORT THIS Tap SKIP, I'LL ADD IT ON MY COMPUTER Tap SEND REPORT A player warning in the dock, here E-8307: USB ACCESS ERROR, with REPORT THIS. REPORT THIS Opens REPORT AN ISSUE about this error. Touch only: with the encoder, open EXTRAS › REPORT AN ISSUE. In MODERN a deck's counter error keeps the dock's top row, with REPORT THIS beside SHOW DECK. REPORT THIS Reports this error. SHOW DECK closes MODS onto the deck.

manual:c2a8f9b265841bf8dcf1.source: The report holds facts the player can check, never text read from its screens: the topic and your words, if any; the XZ Mods version and a fingerprint of your settings, with a few of them (stems, gate cue, interface, theme, deck view, browse preview); the loader ID from ABOUT and the ID of the computer that made the loader, so the report reaches your own XZ Mods app; the screen MODS was opened from (PLAY, BROWSE and so on), the interface, the deck view and the code of any error on screen; known status codes from the four-deck bridge and the player, and the recent entries of the USB diary on this stick. It never holds music, track or playlist names, file names or network addresses. Only the maintainer reads it. You can also report from the XZ Mods app. See Messages and troubleshooting .

manual:c9ddf359cea42247cdc0.source: Press MENU Tap EXTRAS Tap ABOUT XZ MODS Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise The About page with XZMODS.COM highlighted and its QR code shown. Credits Who made XZ Mods. Links XZMODS.COM, INSTAGRAM, BOOK OPTICMYSTIC, VJ.TOOLS, GITHUB / SOURCE, CREDITS / NOTICES and SUPPORT / CASH APP. QR code The highlighted link as a QR code. Scan it with your phone. Address The link the QR code opens. Thanks Thanks, and a reminder that XZ Mods is an independent project. Loader The ID of this stick's loader, written by the XZ Mods app. Reports from this stick carry it. An older loader shows Loader: not identified and can still report. Turn the encoder to a link, then push or tap it to show it as a QR code. Scan the code for CREDITS / NOTICES to read the full credits, licences and matching source. Support is voluntary. Every feature stays available without it.

manual:0c9527bee463fe5b077e.source: The XZ Mods app runs on your computer. It puts XZ Mods on a USB, makes stems for your tracks, makes your DJ profile, keeps the app and your USB up to date, holds tools for your library, games and the XZ screen, and sends your reports and ideas to the maintainer. It never formats a drive and never changes your music or the library your DJ software exported. You need 64-bit Windows with WebView2, or a Mac with macOS 14 or later. Making stems needs a Windows computer or an Apple silicon Mac. On an Intel Mac you can still import stems you made elsewhere.

manual:3ef5b97af5757ed46c75.source: The bar along the top has five sections for your work, then the Manual and About and, on the right, Feedback. The section you are in is filled yellow. The page sits on the raised panel below it. Section What it is for USB Install or update XZ Mods on a USB, add your DJ profile and games Stems Make stems for the tracks on your music USB, or import stems you already have DJ Profile Your name and logo on the XZ, and the profile track Updates App updates, the XZ Mods version for your USB, and network updates for your XZ Tools Repair library, Game downloads and XZ Screen Manual This manual, with search, animations and your place in it About The app, its maker, links, disclaimers and open-source licenses Feedback Report a problem, request a feature or ask a question, and follow what you sent Tools, Updates and the Manual list what they hold down the left, beside the page: the tools, the three Updates pages, or the manual's chapters. The button at the far left of the top bar hides that list and shows it again, and the app remembers your choice. The top left names the player firmware the app prepares USBs for, XDJ-XZ 1.26. The app version is at the top right. In a narrower window point at Preview to see it. The app opens as large as its pages need, but never larger than your screen. In a narrow window the sections show only their icons. Point at one to see its name. The list on the left then opens over the page from the button at the top left, and closes when you pick something.

manual:e5630e5129a30a13971e.source: USB is the first page. Plug in your XZ USB, or any USB stick, and the app finds it. When only one USB is connected, it opens by itself. No USB yet. The app keeps looking, so plug one in. Write to a folder instead… prepares a folder on this computer Several USBs. Each card says whether XZ Mods is on it yet and whether it holds music exported from your DJ software

manual:5d93cdd06fc827319980.source: The USB list shows every connected USB the app can write XZ Mods to. Any file system works, FAT32 or exFAT, and each card shows it beside the drive letter. Choose a card to open that USB. Two USBs and a folder to choose from. One line names the drives the app leaves out. USB A USB the app can write to, with its drive and file system. Write to a folder instead… Prepares a folder on this computer instead of a USB. Drives not shown A read-only USB, or a disk of this computer, with the reason. Look again Searches for USBs at once. Write to a folder instead… puts the loader and its settings in a folder on this computer. Copy everything in it to the top of a USB stick afterward. Games are added only when you write to a USB itself. The list comes back whenever you step back from a USB: Change USB on the dashboard, Cancel in a guide, or Esc on the dashboard. The USB you left does not open by itself again until you plug in or remove a drive, so you can pick another one. Its card is still selected, and Enter opens it again.

manual:a96ba898de98910a2b98.source: Once a USB is open, the page shows one status and one action for it. A fresh USB. XZ Mods is not on it yet, so the one action is Install XZ Mods. Sections USB, Stems, DJ Profile, Updates and Tools. USB The USB's name and drive. Free space The file system, the free space and a bar of how full the USB is. Change USB Goes back to the USB list, to choose another USB or a folder. Status What XZ Mods found on this USB. Action The one thing to do next. Here it installs XZ Mods. DJ profile The active profile on the USB. Add or Edit opens the profile step. Games How many games are on the USB. Choose opens the games list. Stems How many tracks have stems. Prepare opens the Stems section. Build The XZ Mods build that goes on the USB. Change opens XZ Mods version in Updates. Four decks How four decks work. It sets nothing up. See Four decks in the app . Show every file A read-only list of what XZ Mods keeps on this USB. Feedback Reports and ideas for the maintainer. See Feedback . The status changes with what the app finds: Status Action What it means XZ Mods is not on this USB yet Install XZ Mods Adds the loader, free games and your DJ profile. Music and playlists stay as they are. Update available Update USB The USB has an older build. Updating backs up its loader first. See what changes lists what is new. Up to date none The chosen build is already on this USB. Choose which XZ Mods build goes on this USB Use the newest build No build is chosen on this computer yet. The button picks the one that came with the app. No XZ Mods build is on this computer yet Set up mod versions Opens a short guide that finds or imports a build. Update available, with the number of changes Up to date No build chosen yet. Use the newest build picks the one that came with the app

manual:73b36077ea6dca8d9933.source: Install XZ Mods and Update USB open a short guide. The steps that do not apply are left out, so the count at the top changes. Every step ends in the same bar. Back on the left returns to the step before; from the first step it returns to the dashboard. The way forward is on the right. Esc does the same as Back. Cancel at the top leaves the guide without writing anything and shows the USB list, so you can choose another USB or a folder. While the USB is written there is no Back, and the done screen has Done instead, because a write cannot be undone. Your DJ profile. Appears when the USB has no profile yet. Type your name and add a logo, or choose Skip for now and add it later. Choose the screen the XZ shows. New interface (MODERN) or Standard XDJ-XZ interface (CLASSIC). See Getting started . Ready to write. A checklist of everything the write will do. Writing. The progress of each part. Underneath, the app explains four decks while you wait. Done. What was written, what to do on the XZ, and how four decks work. Optional support. A thank-you page with a voluntary support link. Every feature works whether you contribute or not. Four decks is not a step of the guide. Nothing about it happens while the USB is written: you set it up at the player, whenever you want. See Four decks in the app . Your DJ profile. Skip for now leaves it for later Choose the screen the XZ shows. The selected card plays a short clip of it. Progress Which step you are on. Cancel Leaves the guide. Nothing is written. New interface MODERN. XZ Mods draws the whole player screen. Standard XDJ-XZ interface CLASSIC. The player's own screen with MODS added. Classic themes can restyle it. Switch later How to change your mind on the player: the button above LINK first, then the menu, each with a video of the player. Back The step before. From the first step, the dashboard. Next The next step. Note The two small pictures under the cards show an older version of the MODS menu. On the player, INTERFACE is on the SCREEN page. Ready to write, with Change games open. Under the list, a line says music, playlists and prepared stems are never touched. Loader Adds the XZ Mods loader, or backs up and updates it. Games The free games that will be copied. Interface The screen the XZ starts with. Settings file A USB without settings gets a new settings file. Change games Opens or hides the games list. Add all free games Ticks every download. None unticks the ones not on the USB yet. Game state WILL ADD, NOT ON USB, or already on the USB. Add Ticks one game. The size is what it adds to the USB. Back The step before. Write to USB Writes everything in the checklist. Beat Arcade, Wave Rider, Rhythm Lab and Static Surfer are built into the loader and always come with it. Doom shareware, Chex Quest and Freedoom Phase 2 are free downloads that the app checks and copies to VJTOOLS\Games on the USB. A fresh USB gets every free game unless you untick it. An update keeps the games the USB already has and adds none on its own. Under the checklist, Eject the USB when writing finishes ejects it for you so you can take it straight to the XZ. Press Write to USB in the bar under the checklist. If a newer build needs a setting changed on the USB, the app first asks in Adjust USB settings for this version . It saves a copy of the settings file first and puts it back if the loader write fails. Your USB is ready. Four decks and the optional support link follow further down. Result Your USB is ready, or Finished, with something to check. What was written One line per part. A game that did not download says why. On the XZ What to do with the USB next, and how to switch between CLASSIC and MODERN with the button above LINK . Four decks How four decks work. See Four decks in the app . Done Back to the dashboard. Eject USB Ejects the USB so you can unplug it. Under Four decks, Support XZ Mods (optional) opens the optional support page, and Eject the USB by itself next time ejects the USB on its own after the next write. If a game download failed, Retry the failed games tries only those, and the USB is not ejected until you have. When the write also saved a DJ profile, Make the profile track opens the profile track steps. Writing. The progress of each part shows inside the guide The USB is ejected and can be unplugged

manual:b07c66fad2ba4143cb89.source: Four decks is set up at the player, so the app explains it rather than asking you to do anything. The USB list and the dashboard show a Four decks row. While a USB is written, and again on the done screen, a Four decks section shows the cable animation and the three things to do at the player. The Four decks section on the done screen. Four decks Experimental. Nothing to do now. You set it up at the player when you want it. Cable animation The loopback cable from the rear USB-B socket to a top port. The animation shows USB 1; USB 2 works too. Pause cable animation Stops and starts the animation. With reduced motion turned on, the app shows a still picture. At the player Cable from the rear USB-B socket to top USB 1 or 2, music in the other top port (a stick, or one USB 2.0 hub), and CH 3 INPUT and CH 4 INPUT set to USB. How four decks work Opens the Four decks chapter of this manual. How four decks work and the Four decks row both open the Four decks chapter of this manual. If the build just written has no four-deck engine, the section says so and offers Choose the four-deck build , which opens the four-deck build choice in XZ Mods version . Save it, then update the USB.

manual:643c2ff77932a4ee879c.source: Stems makes vocal, harmonic and drum stems for the tracks on your music USB and writes them beside each track. Plug in the USB your DJ software exports your music to. The app lists every track on it. Your tracks and the library your DJ software exported stay as they are. Twelve tracks selected and the stem engine set up. USB Your music USB. Its menu also offers Choose a folder and Look for USBs again. Tracks How many tracks the USB holds and how many have stems. Estimate How many tracks you selected, about how much space their stems take and what is left after. Prepare Makes stems for the selected tracks. The label counts them. Engine The stem engine and the quality in use. Change sets another quality. Tabs Show All, Missing, Ready, Can't prepare, or only the Selected tracks. Search Finds a title or artist. Import stems Brings in stems you made elsewhere. Select Ticks a track. The box in the header ticks every Missing track in view. Status Ready, Missing, Not yet, No audio file, Preparing, Queued, Failed or Damaged. Details Opens the track's details. Status What it means What to do Ready Stems are on the USB Nothing. Open the details to Verify them Missing No stems yet Select it and prepare Not yet XZ Mods cannot prepare this format yet, such as AIFF Export the track as WAV, FLAC or MP3 No audio file The track's file is not on the USB Export the track to the USB again from your DJ software Failed Preparing stopped, with the reason under it Fix the reason, then Retry Damaged Verify found a broken stem page Select it and prepare it again Prepare again Made by an older version Open the details and choose Prepare again A batch holds up to 100 tracks. The estimate turns amber when space gets tight and red when the selection does not fit. The button then reads Prepare N that fit and prepares the tracks in order until the next one would not fit. While a batch runs, each row moves from Queued to Preparing to Ready, and the bar shows the track, the step and about how long is left. The first time on a new computer it says Timing this computer until it has measured. Cancel stops within a second. Finished tracks are kept. When the batch ends, the bar offers the next step. No music USB found. Connect a USB opens a short guide to find or choose one The selection does not fit. Prepare 7 that fit A batch running, with the step and the time left Finished with one failure. Retry 1 failed After a batch What it offers A track failed Retry N failed You pressed Cancel Prepare N remaining The USB was unplugged Continue . Nothing is left half-written The USB filled up Choose fewer tracks Open a row for its details. A Ready track shows who prepared it and offers Verify , which reads every stem page without changing the USB, Import stems to replace them, and Prepare again . Prepare again keeps the current stems until the new ones pass their check.

manual:d77a2bf2d2726ae3d0bb.source: The first time, the button reads Set up stem engine . It opens a short guide that ends on a working engine. Check. The app looks at this computer's graphics card or processor. Choose. Pick a quality. The recommended one is marked for this computer. Install. The app downloads what the engine needs once and checks every file. Test. It separates 30 seconds of your first selected track and tells you how long a whole track will take. Nothing is written to the USB. Quality Use it for Balanced The best quality. Recommended with a graphics card or Apple silicon Fast Good separation in about half the time. Recommended without a graphics card Light Computers without a graphics card and with little memory. Vocals bleed more If setup cannot finish, it names the one reason and offers the fix. For example, when the graphics driver is too old, Use the processor sets up the engine on the processor instead. Set up stem engine replaces Prepare until the engine is set up Step 1. The graphics card the engine will use Step 2. Choose quality Step 3. What it downloads, and the free space on this computer Step 4. The test result, then Prepare 12 tracks The driver is too old. Use the processor, or update the driver and check again

manual:725fdaccb68064013ee6.source: Choose Import stems in the toolbar, or Import stems made elsewhere in a track's details. Drop stem files or a ZIP into the window, or choose files. WAV, FLAC, MP3 and AIFF sets work. Add files. From the toolbar, also pick which track the stems are for. Check. The app places each file on VOCALS, DRUMS or HARMONICS by its name and lines the stems up with the track on your USB. Change any Goes to choice you disagree with. Leave out skips a file. Write. Write stems to USB writes the stems and checks them. Two files need a place. Play a file to hear what it is Stems written and checked A vocals and instrumental pair needs the stem engine to pull the drums out of the instrumental. If the engine is not set up yet, the import offers Set up stem engine and carries on afterward. To use stems on the player, see Stems .

manual:3fdad271707adb61a746.source: DJ Profile makes and edits the profiles on a USB. A profile is your name, logo and colour. The XZ shows each profile as a logo tile, and the active one is the DJ the XZ and VJ software on the same network see. Profiles are saved on the USB only. Nothing is uploaded. To use them on the player, see Connect and DJ profiles . A new profile. DJ name Your name as it should read on the XZ. Logo A PNG or JPEG up to 8 MB. A transparent PNG looks best. You can add alternate logos. Colour The profile colour. The first swatch matches the USB's colour in your DJ software. On the XZ The header and the logo tile as the XZ draws them. What VJ software sees Your name and links as VJ software reads them. More An optional tagline, links and more. The profiles on a USB after a save. Create profile track The next step after a save. Profile tile One tile per profile. Active The profile the XZ uses. Edit Changes this profile. New DJ profile Adds another profile to the USB. Profile track A track that carries your profile to players that cannot read extra files. Some newer players block reading extra files from the USB. A profile track is a silent song that carries your name, logos and links, so it reaches them through your DJ software like any other track. Making a profile track. Steps Where, Create, then Add it to your library. This computer Saves the track in your Music folder, ready for your DJ software. Choose folder Saves the track somewhere else. Copy on the USB Also puts a copy in your profile folder on the USB. Create or Cancel Makes the track, or leaves without one.

manual:b8a71ab2a68f261166c9.source: Updates keeps every version in one place, on three pages listed on the left: App updates for this app, XZ Mods version for the build that goes on your USB, and Network updates to send that build to XZs on your network. Updates opens on App updates. A yellow dot on Updates and on App updates in its list means a newer app is ready.

manual:7d359c62847e91ca1cec.source: The app is up to date. Updates pages App updates, XZ Mods version and Network updates. Updates opens on App updates. Version The app version on this computer. Status Up to date, or the newer version on offer. Check for updates Checks now. Download and install update appears when there is one. What's new The release notes. Other downloads The installer and the portable ZIP. On Windows the app checks for updates by itself at launch and shows Review update at the top of the page when one is ready. The installer updates the app and opens it again. Mac versions download from the release page. Caution Updating the app does not change the loader on your USB. Open the USB page afterward and choose Update USB .

manual:da03ab9f05d2c81ca14e.source: XZ Mods version chooses which build goes on your USB the next time you install or update it. Saving your choice does not write to any USB. The saved build choice. Verified Says whether the build was checked on a real XDJ-XZ. Saved choice The build your next install or update uses. Details Its channel, whether it stays on the USB and where it came from. Change mod version Every build on this computer. Keep this version on the USB A loader built with this on skips network updates, so the USB stays on this build. Save choice and Import a build Saves the choice, or adds a build from a folder. Set up four decks Chooses the included four-deck build. Restore or update a loader by hand Updates the loader on a USB you choose and keeps a backup of the old one. Lower on the page: Restore or update a loader by hand updates the loader on a USB you choose and keeps a backup of the old one. Music and saved settings stay in place. Prepare from a downloaded firmware file builds a loader from an official XDJ-XZ 1.26 firmware file into a folder you choose. Import a build takes a prepared XZ Mods resources folder, or a whole XZ Mods app folder that holds one. The app checks every file before it adds the build. Imported builds are not checked on a real XDJ-XZ.

manual:c55059de65391465048b.source: Network updates sends the build installed on this computer to XZs on your local network. Each XZ checks the signed update, saves it on its USB and starts it at the next boot. The update server, before it starts. Choose mod version A USB built with Keep this version on the USB ignores network updates. Change that here. Detect adapters Lists this computer's network connections. XZ network adapter The connection that reaches the XZ. Start update server Offers the update on that network until you cancel. On the XZ What to do on the player. Prepare or update the USB loader once, so it supports network updates. Choose Detect adapters , then the adapter connected to the XZ network. Choose Start update server . On the XZ, open CONNECT › UPDATES , then download the update. See Updates over the network . Switch the XZ off and on when you are ready to start the new version. Network updates change XZ Mods and the game engine. They keep your music and the original USB loader, so you can always go back. Cancel stops the server. Note The app's step 3 still says MODS › Extras › Network updates. On the player the page is CONNECT › UPDATES.

manual:c98bf71544ff3c7d1e46.source: Tools holds what you need now and then, grouped by what it works on: your USB and your XZ. The list on the left holds the same tools, so you can go straight from one to another. Tools in the top left of each tool goes back to this page. Every tool, in two groups. Repair library Fixes a music USB the XZ cannot read. Game downloads Gets the free games again and copies them to a USB. XZ Screen Shows the XZ screen on this computer, ready for OBS. Updates App updates, XZ Mods version and Network updates have their own section in the top bar. Feedback Reports and ideas have their own section at the right of the top bar.

manual:7bf87701ed52fd724b03.source: Repair library checks the music library your DJ software exported to a USB the XZ cannot read. It can clear invalid unused pages and reconnect playback history pages that survived. It keeps track records, playlists, music and prepared stems. Step 1, choose the USB. USB Your music USB or a folder holding a copy of it. Choose folder and Find USBs Picks a folder, or looks for USBs again. Connect a USB Appears when no USB is found. Opens a short guide to connect one. Read only Checking only reads the library. Choose the USB. Then choose Check library . Library check. The verdict, what the library holds and what is wrong. Save report keeps the result on this computer. Repair plan. What changes and what stays the same. Back up and repair backs up the library files first. If the DJ software that writes the USB is open on this computer, the check says so and offers Prepare for repair . Close it so both apps do not write at the same time, then check again. After a repair, Undo this repair puts the library files back exactly as they were before it.

manual:a832db0196b4dcb05c7e.source: Game downloads gets the free games again and copies them to a USB. Use it to retry a download that failed while the app wrote your USB, or to add the games to a USB that already has XZ Mods. Games already on the USB stay in place. The free games. Choose USB and set up games Downloads and checks every free game, keeps its license notice and copies it to the USB you choose. One game Download keeps the game on this computer. Download and copy to USB also puts it on a USB. Doom shareware , Chex Quest and Freedoom Phase 2 each have their own download. Put your own compatible WADs in a WADS folder on either USB, then choose a base game and an optional add-on in the XZ's USB WAD loader. Downloading games does not change the XZ loader.

manual:3f9e97c44738ca746e2b.source: XZ Screen shows the XDJ-XZ screen on this computer over the network, so you can add it to an OBS scene. It sends the picture only, no audio, and the XZ keeps all its controls. Before the first connection. Set up Live Streamer Opens the three-step connection guide. Stop stream and Fullscreen Work once the XZ is connected. Stream color 8-bit with 256 colors, or 16-bit with the original colors. A change applies when you reconnect. Status What the connection is doing, and the frame rate it measures. Screen The XZ screen at 800 × 480 once it is connected. The connection guide. Look again Searches the network for the XZ again. XZ address Found by itself, or type the address the XZ shows. Network details The ports a firewall must allow, UDP 50006 and TCP 50010. Open USB setup Older USB loaders have no screen service. Update the loader on the USB page. Status Found your XZ, still looking, or what stopped it. Connect and Close The first picture from the XZ confirms the connection. Connect this computer and the XZ to the same network, for example the same router or a network cable between them. Choose Set up Live Streamer . The app looks for the XZ at once. If the guide asks, update the USB loader on the USB page, then switch the XZ off and on with both decks stopped. The guide never restarts the XZ. Choose Connect . To use the picture in OBS, add a Browser source, paste the OBS Browser Source URL , and set its width to 800 and height to 480 . Copy OBS URL copies it. Keep the app running. The URL works on this computer only and changes when you reconnect. Tick Show a logo while browsing USB to cover the stream with the XZ Mods logo while you browse your USB. The play screen comes back on its own. Menus, custom themes and screens the app does not recognise stay covered. With an older USB loader the picture updates about once a second and the status says it is not performance video. Update the USB loader appears beside it.

manual:c63bd7c1619c0ad11008.source: Manual is this manual, inside the app. It comes with the app, so it needs no internet connection. Where the app explains a feature, Read in the manual opens the chapter about it. Four decks open in the Manual, at the video of how the sound of decks 3 and 4 reaches the mixer. Manual Opens the manual. It sits between Tools and About in the top bar. Search Searches every chapter as you type. Press / to get here from anywhere on the page, and Enter to open the first result. Progress How much of the manual you have read. A chapter's circle fills as you read and turns into a tick at its end. Start page What XZ Mods adds, the interface you play on, and every chapter in order. Menu map Every screen of the player as a flow chart. See The menu map . Chapter list Every chapter, on the left beside the page. The one you are reading is outlined and lists its sections. Chapter The chapter you are reading. Previous and Next at its end move through the manual in order. Video A clip rendered from a true-scale model of the XDJ-XZ shows how a feature works. It plays when it comes into view, and Play pauses it. A video in several steps also has arrows and numbered steps, and its caption follows the step. How-to videos. Many sections show how to get there on the player: the player's screen, beside a true-scale picture of the key, rotary selector or pad you use, pressed in time with the screen. The steps under the video light up as it reaches them. Click a step to play from there. Where a section shows more than one way, the tabs above the steps switch between them. Numbers on pictures. Point at a number, or tab to it and use the arrow keys, to light up that part of the picture and read what it is. Play steps through every number. The list under the picture says the same. Your interface. Choose MODERN, CLASSIC or Both on the start page or at the foot of the chapter list. The manual then hides what does not apply to you. A MODS page drawn in both interfaces has a MODERN and CLASSIC switch on its picture. Where you stopped. The manual remembers the chapter and section you read last. The start page offers Continue where you left off . Less motion. When your computer is set to reduce motion, nothing in the manual moves by itself. A video shows a still picture of each step and plays only when you press Play.

manual:665f127476cb05339f0b.source: Menu map , under the start page in the chapter list, shows every screen on the player and how to get to it, as a flow chart. The play screen is on the left, and what each key opens fans out to its right. Every branch is labelled with the control that opens it: a key such as MENU , the rotary selector, or a tap on a word on the screen. The menu map at BEAT JUMP PADS, opened with MENU, then PLAY, then BEAT JUMP PADS. Interface MODERN or CLASSIC. The map starts on the interface you chose for the manual. Find a screen Type the name of a screen and press Enter to go to it. View Zoom out and in, fit the whole map, open every branch, or close them back to the MODS sections. Show every state lays out every state of every screen. Path How you got here from the play screen, one control at a time. Click a step to go back to it. Jump to The play screen and what each of its keys opens. Screen The screen you picked, outlined in yellow, as are the branches that lead to it. The number on its picture counts its states. Control The control that opens the screen. A keycap is a key on the player; a tap names the words on the screen. The screen The screen at full size. Its states follow below it, then the parts you can pick, how you get here and where it leads. States Each state of the screen as you turn the rotary selector or change a value, and the control between them. Read in the manual Opens the part of this manual that explains the screen. Room to work. The chapter list folds away while the map is open, so the map has the width. The button at the far left of the top bar brings the list back. Move around. Drag the map to move it. The mouse wheel, or the + and − keys on your computer, zoom in and out, and 0 fits the whole map. In a wide window the small map in the corner shows where you are; click it to go there. Branches. The number beside a screen opens the screens after it, and − closes them again. The map opens with the MODS sections closed, so the first view stays readable. Keys. The arrow keys walk the map: right into a branch, left back out, up and down to the screens beside it. Enter opens a screen and Esc closes it. Previous screen and Next screen at the foot of a screen walk the whole map in order. From a chapter. A section of the manual about a screen has On the menu map beside its heading. It opens the map at that screen.

manual:bf7fcefaf4f4d40978ed.source: About says what XZ Mods is and who makes it, and gathers the links, the disclaimers and the open-source licenses in one place. About. Version The app version on this computer. Maker XZ Mods is made by OpticMystic. App updates and release notes Opens App updates in Updates. The maker OpticMystic's projects: XZ Mods, VJ.Tools and DJ Profile. Make yours opens DJ Profile. Links The source code, issues and releases on GitHub, xzmods.com and vj.tools. Each opens in your browser. Feedback Opens Feedback in the app. Support XZ Mods (optional) Voluntary support on Cash App. Every feature stays available. Disclaimers XZ Mods is independent of the maker of the XDJ-XZ, experimental, runs from the USB, and builds its loader from the official firmware for your own use. Open license notices Every open-source project XZ Mods uses and its license.

manual:d2ad4333312c6eed405e.source: Feedback is where you tell the maintainer about a problem, ask for a feature or ask a question, and follow what you sent. It sits at the right of the top bar on every page. The Feedback section. Feedback Opens this section from any page. A count on it shows reports from your XZ that wait for your words. Report a problem Opens the report window at its first question. Request a feature Opens the report window at the kind of idea. Ask a question Goes straight to the box. Answers from this manual appear as you type. My reports What you sent from this computer and where each report is now. Maintainer inbox For the maintainer only. Reports from your XZ that wait for your words appear above My reports, under From your XZ . The sticks that may send them are listed under Your XZ sticks .

manual:b8fb09a381a394fd75d9.source: The report window sends a private report to the maintainer: a problem, something that got worse, an idea or a question. Report a problem in Feedback opens it at the first question. Request a feature and Ask a question answer that question for you. The only thing you have to fill in is one box. Nothing is posted publicly. The first question. Steps Where you are. The box with Send is always the last step. Topic Pick the closest one. The next question depends on it. How do I...? For a question. Answers from this manual appear as you type. Not sure Skips the question. Every question has it. Cancel Closes the window. What you typed comes back when you open it again. Pick what it is about, or Not sure . Answer at most two more short questions, or press Not sure . Write what happened in your own words. One sentence is enough. Press Send privately . You pick It then asks Something got worse When it got worse, then for the USB sticks that were in the XZ Something isn't working What kind of problem: sound, SYNC or tempo, the screen, buttons and pads, loading and USB, four decks, a crash, or something else It should work differently Compared with what: the XZ before XZ Mods, another XZ feature, other DJ gear or software, an earlier XZ Mods version, or just your preference. For gear or another feature, which one I have a new idea What kind of idea How do I...? Nothing more. Go straight to your question The box, with an answer from this manual. Your answers What you picked. Change goes back to the first question. The box The only thing you have to fill in. Up to 4,096 bytes; a counter appears near the limit. Is this it? Up to three answers from this manual that match what you typed. Answer buttons Set up four decks opens that setup. That answers it closes without sending anything. Included details What the app collected to send with your words. Closed until you open it. Send privately Sends your words and the details shown, to the maintainer only. As you type, Is this it? shows answers from this manual. The matching runs on your computer; your words are not sent anywhere for it. If an answer solves it, its button opens the right setup, such as Set up four decks , or That answers it closes the window. Nothing is sent.

manual:9b65aee142c8772308ee.source: While you answer and type, the app reads the details that help the maintainer, for at most 10 seconds: the session log and settings on your XZ Mods USB, the diary on each stick, the app's events and the build. Everything is cleaned first. No track names, file paths, serial numbers or network addresses are kept. Included details, opened, with one source shown and one left out. Included details How many sources are included, their size and the time around the problem they cover. A source What it is and where it comes from. Untick it to leave it out. Show The exact content that would be sent for this source. Left out An unticked source is not sent. Exact content What is sent for this source, after cleaning. Send privately sends exactly your words and the ticked details shown at that moment. If you send before the app has finished reading, it sends what it has read and notes what is missing. Collect again reads everything again. Ideas include no details at all, only your words. Details are deleted after 14 days.

manual:741c8c418b27dfc011f8.source: For something that got worse, the app asks you to plug in every USB stick that was in the XZ when it happened. XZ Mods versions that keep a diary write it to each stick while the XZ plays. The app reads only that diary, never your music. Two sticks plugged in: an XZ Mods USB with a diary and a music stick without one. XZ Mods USB A stick with the XZ Mods loader on it. Diary The time range the diary on this stick covers. Music stick A stick with music only. No diary on this stick This stick has no diary, for example from a version that does not keep one. That's all of them Goes on to the box. Each stick appears by itself as you plug it in. Press That's all of them when every stick is in. A missing stick or a missing diary never stops you sending.

manual:f9152da4148072818430.source: The receipt after sending. Your reference The permanent reference for this report, also shown in My reports. Status Where the report is now. Copy Copies the reference so you can quote it to the maintainer. Track my report Opens it in My reports. Every accepted report or idea gets its own reference, such as R-4F7K-2M9Q . Quote it when asking about that report. Copy copies the reference. The reference stays the same if you send again after a connection failure. It does not let anyone read your report or its status. If the app cannot confirm that a report arrived, it says Not confirmed yet . Nothing is lost. Set up reporting connection checks the internet connection and the computer's clock, then Send again sends the same report. If the first attempt did arrive, you get its receipt and nothing arrives twice. Save to a file keeps a copy without sending. The setup after a send that was not confirmed. Connection Whether this computer is online. Clock Secure connections fail when the date is wrong. Send again Sends the same report again.

manual:027d4dab83427605e328.source: My reports lists every report and idea sent from this computer, with its kind and where it is now, in plain words. It is the list under the buttons in Feedback. Four reports, one with news. Kind Such as Problem, Got worse, Works differently, Idea or Question. Your words The start of what you wrote. It stays on this computer. Status Where the report is now. New marks a change you have not opened yet. Reference and date Your report reference and the day you sent it. Part of XZ-1042 appears when the maintainer assigns an item. Check now Checks every report at once, and asks for new reports from your XZ. When a report's status changes, a notice appears at the top of whichever page is open. A status change, shown while App updates is open. Notice Appears when the status of one of your reports changes. View Opens that report. The app checks for news when it starts, after it checks for app updates, and when you open My reports, at most every 15 minutes for each report. Check now checks at once. If you are offline, the last known status stays. Open a report to see where it is. The view is read-only. Once the maintainer assigns it, Part of XZ-1042 names the bug, feature or question it belongs to. Reports about the same item share that item number. If the maintainer moves your report to another item, this number changes; your R reference stays the same. Item numbers remain after the report's details are deleted. A problem the maintainer confirmed, with a fix in progress. Progress Received, Confirmed, Fix in progress, Ready to test, In an update. Ideas and questions show Received, Looked at, Decided. Reference This report's permanent reference and kind. Your words The start of what you wrote. Status Where it is now, in plain words. Dates When you sent it, the last change, when its details are deleted and how long tracking lasts. Status link and forgetting The status link, and Forget this report. Check now Checks this report at once. Part of The item this report belongs to, such as XZ-1042. If the maintainer needs one more detail, the question appears in the report. Answer in a new report starts a report that names this one. Open status page and Copy status link give a read-only web page with the same status, report reference and item number. It shows none of your words or details. Anyone with the link can read the status. Turn off status links stops every link for this report; the app still checks it. Forget this report removes its receipt from this computer. The maintainer keeps the report. A report saved, but not sent, by an older version of the app appears under Saved, not sent . Use this text starts a new report with its words. Details are deleted 14 days after you send them. Tracking lasts while a report is open, up to one year without news, then 180 days after it closes. A fix in a local test build is not a published update.

manual:66030e7b50ccd179232a.source: A report sent from the XZ waits in Feedback for your words. From your XZ appears above My reports while one waits. The XZ notes the screen you were on as names only. It keeps no picture and no text from the screen. A report from the XZ, waiting for your words. From your XZ Reports from your XZ that wait for your words. Reference and time The report's reference and when the XZ sent it. It stays the same when you add your words. Screen The screen the XZ showed just before you reported, with any error code on it. Stick The stick the report came from, and when XZ Mods wrote it. Typed on the XZ What you typed on the XZ, if anything. What happened? Starts with what you typed on the XZ. Change it or add to it. Collected details What the XZ collected and sent with the report. Show displays each part exactly. Stop reminding Ends the reminders for this report. It stays in the list. Send without comments Finishes the report without words from you. Send Adds your words to the same report. Send adds your words to the same report, under the same reference. The report then moves to your sent reports, where you follow it like any other. Send without comments finishes the report as it is. If the app can't reach the report service, it keeps your words and sends them by itself later. You can close the app. The XZ already sent the collected details. They are deleted 14 days after it sent them. After that the report says so, and your words still reach the maintainer. The maintainer sees the report as soon as the XZ sends it, marked as waiting for your comments, and can start from the logs. The app tells you when a report from the XZ waits: While the app is open, a new report brings a Windows notification, such as "Your XZ sent a report, R-4F7K-2M9Q. Add what happened?" Click it to open that report. Feedback in the top bar shows how many reports wait. When the app starts with reports waiting, a callout under the page title names them. The callout when the app starts with a report waiting. Callout Names the report your XZ sent. It never covers the window or takes the keyboard. Add what happened Opens the report in Feedback with its box ready. Remind me later Hides the callout until the app starts again. Stop reminding Ends the reminders for these reports. They stay in Feedback. Badge How many reports from your XZ wait for your words. Reminders end when you choose Stop reminding , or 7 days after a report arrives. Each report brings one notification at most. If Windows notifications are off for XZ Mods, or your copy of the app is not installed, the badge and the callout tell you instead.

manual:ddfc67074963e1b2a25b.source: Every stick XZ Mods writes gets a loader ID, such as L-7K2M-9Q4F . It lets the XZ send reports from that stick to this computer, and to nothing else. Your XZ sticks , near the bottom of Feedback, lists them. Three sticks: one waiting to register, one ready and one revoked. Your XZ sticks The sticks XZ Mods wrote on this computer. Loader ID Reports from this stick carry it. Written When XZ Mods last wrote the stick. State Can send reports, Registers when online, Plug it in to finish, Revokes when online or Revoked. Revoke Stops this stick sending reports. The app asks first. Revoke a stick you lost or gave away. The XZ can no longer send reports from it. If you are offline, the stick is revoked on this computer at once and the report service hears of it later. Writing XZ Mods to that stick again gives it a new key, and it can send reports again. Plug it in to finish means a write to that stick was not confirmed. Plug the stick in with the app open. If the state stays, write XZ Mods to the stick again. With no sticks yet, Set up a USB opens the USB setup.

manual:29b02ef2244bad82b9dd.source: Maintainer inbox , at the bottom of Feedback, is for the maintainer. Connect it with the report-only owner key. The short setup checks that key by reading the inbox. Enter a report reference or item number in the search box and choose Find . You can type either case, with or without spaces and dashes. For a report reference, I or L also means 1, and O means 0. A report reference finds one report; an item number finds the reports assigned to that item. Clear returns to the inbox. The inbox, scrolled right to show Reference and Item. Find Searches the whole inbox by report reference or item number. Reference The permanent reference for each report. Item The bug, feature or question the report belongs to. A dash means it has not been assigned yet. Scroll Scroll right or left to see every column. The reference and item number identify a report; the owner key is still required to read the inbox.

manual:c3d2675ae02d58da9876.source: Choose Language / Idioma below the navigation to open XZ language setup. It detects the bundled offline catalogs, lets you choose a language, imports an optional JSON catalog, then applies the text so you can verify it on screen. No account or translation service is required. This setting belongs to XZ Mods only. Coverage counts describe extracted desktop and manual text. Machine translations require language review. Export a catalog to review text offline; import rejects changed sources, missing placeholders and altered printed control names. After a source change, regenerate all languages against a fresh source snapshot. For local generation, open the independent provider section. Detect saved resources, enter the Python executable and Small100 model folder, then choose Connect and live verify . The test translates a sentence into all 14 languages. Install pinned dependencies creates an XZ-only Python environment using the selected Python and installs the pinned provider packages. It needs network access for those packages, but translation runs locally without credentials or paid services. The Small100 folder must already contain model.bin, shared_vocabulary.json and sentencepiece.bpe.model. Choose Generate all languages to resume the full corpus. Progress and logs remain in the XZ application data directory. Cancel translation stops this job and retains checkpoints. Publication replaces the complete language set only after every locale passes structural validation. This does not establish native-speaker approval. The packaged source snapshot belongs to this XZ release; updating the app supplies a new snapshot. Printed hardware names such as CUE , SHIFT , SYNC , MENU and BACK stay as printed. Track names and stock alerts are not translated. Arabic uses browser right-to-left text layout; fonts come from the operating system. Controller screenshots keep their original labels. Controller mod text still needs Unicode font and layout integration; choosing a desktop language does not change it.

manual:1227edbe830d04358fc7.source: XZ Mods never changes the player's firmware, so the player always starts stock without the USB. Press MENU Tap CONNECT Tap UPDATES Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise Switch the player off. Remove the XZ Mods USB and switch the player on. It starts stock. Play from a stick without XZ Mods if you are in a set. On your computer, open the USB in the XZ Mods app. If it says Update available , choose Update USB . If it says Up to date , open Updates › XZ Mods version › Restore or update a loader by hand and update the loader again. The app keeps a backup of the old loader each time. Try the USB again. If it still does not start, report the problem .
