Check these first: Check Why The player runs firmware 1.26 XZ Mods supports no other firmware version autoexec.bin is at the top of the USB A loader prepared into a folder has to be copied to the USB yourself You updated the USB after updating the app An app update does not change the USB If XZ Mods started after a network update and stopped working, open CONNECT › UPDATES and push PREVIOUS VERSION , then switch the player off and on. See Updates over the network . If the sound goes wrong while you test, stop playback and switch the player off and on. Load the same track again and check the original mix before you go on. Tip MODS is always reachable with the hardware alone. In CLASSIC, the button above LINK switches to MODERN, where MENU opens MODS. Turn the encoder to move, push it to choose and press BACK to go back.

manual:1b793c43cee081a4cd96.source: When a deck cannot play stems, its stem row says why and its last button offers the next step. In CLASSIC the row sits under the deck's waveform. Open the button to see the deck's setup page in MODS. Press MENU Tap STEMS Tap SET UP USB STEMS Tap CHECK STEM ENGINE Tap CHECK THIS DECK AGAIN Tap CHECK THIS DECK AGAIN Tap STEMS READY / BACK TO PLAY Press MENU Deck 1 has a track loaded that has no stems yet. STANDALONE STEMS SETUP The three things stems need, in order. Steps 1 CHECK ENGINE, 2 TURN ON (ALL DECKS), 3 LOAD A PREPARED TRACK. Deck state The deck and why it has no stems. Next step The one thing to do. Deck Choose DECK 1 or DECK 2 to check the other deck. CHECK THIS DECK AGAIN Reads the deck again after you fixed it. State The deck's stem state in a word or two. Stem row says What it means What to do STEMS READY Stems are ready on this deck Nothing NO STEM ENGINE, with SET UP The loader on the USB has no stem engine Update the USB loader with the XZ Mods app, then restart the player STEMS OFF, with TURN ON USB stems are switched off Push TURN ON . It turns USB stems on for decks 1 and 2 NO TRACK LOADED The deck has no track Load a track from the USB NOT PREPARED, with HOW TO FIX The track has no stems on this USB Prepare it in the XZ Mods app, then load it again LOADING STEMS Stems are loading from the USB Wait a moment PLAY TO ALIGN Stems are loaded but not locked to the track yet Press play. Stems lock to the track a few seconds in STEM SET ERROR, with HOW TO FIX The stems on the USB are incomplete or damaged. The page names the problem Verify the track in the XZ Mods app and prepare it again Every state on both interfaces, with pictures, is in Stems .

If it fails again, check the file in your DJ software THE TRACK ON USB 2 COULD NOT BE READ BECAUSE THE DEVICE WAS REMOVED WHILE IT WAS LOADING Plug the USB back in and load the track again USB1 IS NOT CONNECTED, USB2 IS NOT CONNECTED Plug in the USB, or choose the other source USB SOURCE CHANGED: SELECT TRACK AGAIN The USB changed under the list. Choose the track again SELECT A TRACK, THEN PRESS LOAD Highlight a track first OPEN A TRACK LIST TO LOAD, NO USB TRACK LIST TO LOAD FROM Open a track list on a USB, then load LOAD FROM THIS LIST IS OFF Loading from this list is switched off. See Browsing and loading THIS ROW CANNOT BE LOADED, THAT DECK CANNOT LOAD THIS TRACK Choose another track or another deck TAG LIST IS FULL: 100 TRACKS Remove a track from the tag list first MATCHING NEEDS A MASTER DECK Set a master deck, then use MATCHING NO MASTER DECK: BPM FILTER OFF, NO MASTER KEY: KEY FILTER OFF The filter has nothing to compare with. Set a master deck COMPUTER BROWSING IS NOT AVAILABLE YET, LINK BROWSING IS NOT AVAILABLE YET Browse a USB instead. These sources come in a later version LINK DID NOT OPEN, EXPORT MODE DID NOT OPEN Try again. The player's own screen did not open MODS DID NOT OPEN: PUSH AGAIN Push again TOUCH CANNOT OPEN THIS YET: PUSH THE ENCODER Use the encoder for this item THAT SETTING CANNOT CHANGE HERE Change it in the player's own UTILITY. Hold MENU DECK 3 AND 4 ARE NOT RUNNING Set up four decks first. See Four decks KEY SHIFT REFUSED: AUDIO LOAD TOO HIGH The measured audio workload leaves too little headroom for a new shift. Current shifts keep running. Check SYSTEM READOUT and retry when the load falls. See Keys and KEY SYNC THIS DECK IS MASTER KEY SYNC matches a deck to the master. Make another deck the master first A player warning such as E-8307: USB ACCESS ERROR The player raised its own warning window. MODERN says it once in the player's words and keeps working. See The player's own warnings THIS DJ PROFILE CANNOT BE READ Make the profile again in the XZ Mods app. See Connect and DJ profiles

manual:de7d97c8165b1fe4b3fc.source: When the player cannot play a track, XZ Mods shows the player's own error code and text on that deck. XZ Mods never hides these errors. Tap CHOOSE TRACK Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise Press LOAD 1 Press BACK A read error on deck 2. Error The player's own code and text. CHOOSE TRACK Opens browse so you can load another track. EMERGENCY LOOP. The deck loops until you load a track The same error on deck 3, with four decks MODERN. The error covers the deck's lane, with CHOOSE TRACK . While MODS is open, the strip at the top of the dock turns red with each deck's badge, the code, the player's text and SHOW DECK . Tap the strip to close MODS and see the deck. CLASSIC. The player's own error stays visible in the deck's lower area, also while MODS is open. Touches there go to the player. Code Player's text What to do E-8302 CANNOT PLAY TRACK Load another track. Check the USB and the file on a computer E-8304, E-8305 UNSUPPORTED The player cannot play this file. Export it in another format E-8306 NO FILE The file is missing from the USB. Export the track to the USB again from your DJ software E-7206 AUTH CHIP ERROR Switch the player off and on. If it also happens without the XZ Mods USB, the player needs service

manual:c870fe3a610d8a8c85a9.source: The player sometimes raises its own warning window, for example about a USB or a device. A warning never takes the screen or the controls away from XZ Mods. MODERN. The play screen says the warning once, in the player's own words, for example E-8307: USB ACCESS ERROR . Browse, the decks and every control keep working. MODS, in either interface. MODS stays open on the same page. The strip at the top of the dock turns red with the warning's code and text, and REPORT THIS . The strip goes when the warning does. CLASSIC with MODS closed. The player's window shows as on a stock XDJ-XZ. Touches, keys and the encoder go to the player until it closes the window. A player warning in the dock while MODS is open. Warning The player's code and text.

manual:b6df4fb9f5c4568c2cc4.source: The player sees the loopback cable for four decks as a hub. It raises E-8307: HUBS ARE NOT SUPPORTED or E-8307: UNSUPPORTED DEVICE and would keep it up while the cable is in. It is not an error. XZ Mods removes the window as soon as the player draws it, in MODERN, MODS and CLASSIC. See Four decks .

Press MENU Tap SCREEN Tap CLASSIC Tap MODERN Press MENU Message What it means What to do NO SETTINGS USB: CHANGES LAST UNTIL POWER OFF. No USB to save on Insert the XZ Mods USB, or your settings USB NOT SAVED TO USB 1: CHECK USB Writing failed Check the stick is in and not write-protected, then change the setting again USB 1 IS LOCKED: NOT SAVED The stick is write-protected Unlock it, or check it on a computer THE STICK IS FULL: NOT SAVED No space left on the stick Free some space on a computer THIS STICK IS READ-ONLY: NOTHING CHANGES The player opened the stick read-only Check the stick on a computer INVALID USB SETTINGS: KEPT CURRENT, USB 1 SETTINGS INVALID: KEPT CURRENT The settings file on the stick is damaged. The player keeps the settings it has Change any setting to write a new file, or update the USB in the app USB 1 HAS NO SETTINGS: KEPT CURRENT The stick has no settings yet Nothing. Your next change creates them PROFILE APPLIED / NOT SAVED A DJ profile was applied but could not be saved Check the stick is in and not locked SETTINGS SAVE UNAVAILABLE Saving stopped in this session Switch the player off and on NOT SAVED: CHANGES LAST UNTIL POWER OFF., TRIAL RUN: NOTHING SAVED This build runs as a trial that saves nothing Start from a USB prepared in the XZ Mods app to save TRIAL RUN: SETTINGS NOT LOADED A trial build ignores the settings on the stick Start from a prepared USB A padlock beside a setting means XZ Mods shows it but cannot change it there. The help under it says why. See UTILITY, the player's own settings .

manual:68b75d4e5bb90954e123.source: Every "needs setup" state in the app comes with one button that starts a short guide. Press it. Message Button What it does No XZ Mods build is on this computer yet, so there is nothing to write Set up mod versions Finds or imports a build Choose which XZ Mods build goes on this USB Use the newest build Picks the build that came with the app Stem engine not set up yet Set up stem engine Checks the computer, downloads the engine and tests it Connect your music USB Connect a USB Finds a USB or a folder and checks its library Set up Live Streamer to connect to your XZ Set up Live Streamer Finds the XZ on the network and connects Older USB loaders have no screen service Update the USB loader Opens the USB page to update the loader The DJ software that writes this USB is open on this computer Prepare for repair Waits for you to close it, then checks again Not confirmed yet, after sending a report Set up reporting connection Checks the internet connection and the clock, then sends the same report again. It never arrives twice Maintainer inbox, not connected (maintainer only) Connect and check Keeps the owner key under Windows protection and reads the inbox to check it Message What to do USB drives could not be listed Choose Choose a folder instead , or plug the USB in again and choose Look again The USB could not be read Reconnect it and choose it again This is a folder, not a USB Copy the finished autoexec.bin to the top of the USB afterward Nothing to write yet Add a game or a DJ profile, or cancel XZ Mods is updating itself Write to the USB once the app update has finished Finished, with something to check Read the lines under it. Retry the failed games tries only the games that failed Settings were not written Open the USB again and write again Your DJ profile was not saved Read the reason under it, fix it and save the profile again The USB was not ejected Choose Try ejecting again , or eject it from your computer Making stems needs a Windows computer or an Apple silicon Mac Import stems made elsewhere, or make them on another computer The graphics engine needs a newer NVIDIA driver Choose Use the processor , or update the driver and check again The USB is full Choose Choose fewer tracks The USB was disconnected Plug it back in and choose Continue . Nothing was left half-written Every page of the app is in The XZ Mods app .

manual:a8b3ff1802ea99a43acf.source: XZ Mods keeps a short diagnostic diary in VJ.Tools/XZ-Mods-diary/ on each mounted USB stick, including music sticks. If a problem happens during a set, keep those sticks so you can include their diaries in a later report. The diary records the XZ Mods version, settings fingerprint, USB slots, interface, deck view, state changes and fixed notice codes. It also records available CPU, memory, audio, SYNC, key-processing and USB-read measurements. It never records track titles, music paths, serial numbers or network identities. A missing measurement stays unknown. Each stick holds at most 4 MiB of diary files. Older segments are replaced first, and the previous session's latest segment is kept when a new session starts. Writing pauses during track loads, RAM copies and heavy USB reads. No diary is created on a read-only stick or when less than 64 MiB of free space plus a small write reserve remains. Read-only test sessions save nothing. Normal USB-loader sessions write diary entries when these conditions allow it. Long busy periods and removal can leave gaps. The diary stays on the sticks. Nothing is sent until you choose to include it in a report.

manual:c4acc13f2997a386e888.source: When something goes wrong, send a report. It helps fix the problem for everyone. Press MENU Tap REPORT THIS Tap SKIP, I'LL ADD IT ON MY COMPUTER Tap SEND REPORT On the player. Open MODS › EXTRAS › REPORT AN ISSUE , or push REPORT THIS beside an error in the dock. Choose a topic, add words if you like, and send. Offline, the report waits on the stick for your computer. See Report an issue . On your computer. In the XZ Mods app, open Feedback at the top right and choose Report a problem . Only one box is required, and My reports in Feedback shows where your report is afterwards. See Report a problem or share an idea . On GitHub. Open an issue at https://github.com/OpticMystic/XZ-Mods/issues. Say what you did, what you expected and what happened. The app adds the cleaned-up details itself, and you can see and untick each one. Nothing is sent until you press Send privately , and the app posts nothing publicly. From the player, the public GitHub issue is a separate step you submit yourself.

manual:806e9352c051dc13a96f.source: Your settings live in one file on the USB: VJ.Tools/XZ-Mods.cfg . You change them in MODS, or on your computer with the XZ Mods app . There is no save button. Every change saves on its own to the USB you are browsing, and the bottom of the MODS page says what happened for a few seconds. Message Meaning SAVED TO USB 1 (or USB 2) The change is on that USB. NOT SAVED TO USB 1: CHECK USB The USB could not be written. Check that it is not full or locked, then change the setting again. SAVED ON THIS XZ / NO USB No USB is in. The change is kept on this player only. USB REMOVED: SETTINGS KEPT You pulled the USB. The player keeps your settings for the rest of the set. USB 1 HAS NO SETTINGS: KEPT CURRENT The USB you browsed has no settings file. The player keeps the settings it has. USB 1 SETTINGS INVALID: KEPT CURRENT The settings file on that USB could not be read. The player keeps the settings it has. NOT SAVED: CHANGES LAST UNTIL POWER OFF. This start of XZ Mods cannot save. Your changes work until you switch the player off.

manual:4f8cab20ba910f171d2a.source: The player follows the same rules as its own MY SETTINGS: Browsing a USB in USB 1 or USB 2 loads that USB's settings. Browsing a computer or a LINK source never changes them. A USB without settings, or with settings the player cannot read, leaves your current settings as they are. Nothing resets to defaults in the middle of a set. The player remembers the last settings it used. Started without a USB, it uses those. A USB with its own settings takes over again once you browse it. The player's own MY SETTINGS, which your DJ software writes to the USB, are a separate set. XZ Mods settings never change them, and loading MY SETTINGS does not change XZ Mods settings. MODERN's own display choices are settings too: its waveform colour, waveform position and zoom, how it writes keys, the TRACK COLOURS choice, the LAMPS AND TITLES and BYPASS BUTTON switches, and the columns of its track list. So are the 3-band colours. They are saved to the USB with everything else and come back after the player restarts. Things you do during a set, such as muting a stem, BYPASS, a key shift, KEY SYNC or a RAM copy, are not settings. They start fresh every time the player starts.

manual:ab1be902d228ff964e10.source: There is no single button that resets every setting. Set each one back in MODS, using the Default column below. Some pages have their own way back: PAGE 1: STOCK for beat jump page 1, RESET STEM COLORS for the stem colours, and RESET 3-BAND COLOURS for the 3-band colours. Note Deleting the settings file from the USB does not reset anything. The player keeps the settings it has, and saves them to the USB again with your next change.

browse.title: Browsing and loading
browse.html:
This chapter covers finding a track and putting it on a deck. MODERN has its own browse screens, built for touch and the rotary encoder. CLASSIC uses the player's own browse screens and adds the key, colours for compatible keys and a few labels to them.

Browsing in MODERN modern

Press BROWSE or TAG LIST to open that list, or hold BROWSE for SEARCH. PLAYLIST is in the BROWSE category rail and on the SHORTCUT screen. Press BACK to go up one level. At the top of a list BACK opens SOURCE, where you pick the USB to browse.

    1. Press BROWSE
    2. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 7 clicks clockwise, then push it
    3. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise, then push it
    4. Press BACK
    5. Press BACK

Moving through a list modern

    1. Press BROWSE
    2. Push ROTARY SELECTOR
    3. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 5 clicks clockwise
    4. Press BACK
ControlWhat it does
Turn the encoderMoves the highlight one row
Push the encoderOpens a folder. On a track, opens the track menu: LOAD TO DECK for each deck, CUE / LOOP LIST when the track has memory points and the deck can load at one, and CANCEL. The active deck is highlighted, so a second push loads it there
Hold the encoderTurns letter jump on. Turning then jumps by first letter, or by page where the list has no index. Push or hold again to stop
Drag or flick the listScrolls
Tap a rowHighlights it and shows LOAD
BACKUp one level. At the top, opens SOURCE
MENUOpens the list's MENU panel: sort, columns and the track menu
INFOOpens or closes the INFO panel

The preview column starts hidden. One tap on PREVIEW shows it, and XZ Mods remembers your choice on the USB (browse_preview). PREVIEW is touch only.

Loading a track modern

There are three ways to load the highlighted track:

    1. Press BROWSE
    2. Push ROTARY SELECTOR
    3. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 3 clicks clockwise
    4. Press LOAD 1
    5. Press BACK
  • Tap the row, then tap 1 or 2 on its LOAD chip.
  • Push the encoder twice to load on the active deck, or push, turn to another deck and push.
  • Press the LOAD button of the deck you want.

If no track is highlighted, LOAD says SELECT A TRACK, THEN PRESS LOAD. On a screen that is not a track list it says OPEN A TRACK LIST TO LOAD. To load onto decks 3 and 4, see Four decks.

INFO panel modern

Press INFO or tap INFO to open a panel with the highlighted track's details beside the list. The list narrows to make room.

    1. Press INFO
    2. Tap the screen
    3. Tap the screen
    4. Tap the screen
    5. Tap the screen
    6. Tap the screen

Sort, columns and the track menu modern

Press MENU or tap a column title. The MENU panel opens on the right with the sort order, the columns to show, and the actions for the highlighted track.

    1. Press BROWSE
    2. Push ROTARY SELECTOR
    3. Press MENU
    4. Tap CUE/LOOP LIST
    5. Tap INTRO CUE

Filter modern

Tap FILTER to narrow the list without leaving it. The filters stay on while you move between categories, and a chip in the header says which are on.

    1. Press BROWSE
    2. Press TRACK FILTER
    3. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise, then push it
    4. Press BACK
FilterWhat it keeps
BPMTracks within a range of the master deck's BPM, for example MASTER ±6
MATCH MASTER KEYTracks whose key mixes with the master deck's key
AT LEASTTracks rated at least that many stars
COLORTracks with any of the colours you tick
MY TAGNot available yet

CLEAR ALL FILTERS in the panel, or a tap on the chip, turns every filter off. Filters that compare with the master deck need one. Without it you see NO MASTER DECK: BPM FILTER OFF or NO MASTER KEY: KEY FILTER OFF.

Search modern

Hold BROWSE (SEARCH is printed above it), or tap SEARCH on the SHORTCUT screen. Type on the keyboard and the list updates as you type. SEARCH puts the keyboard away so you can scroll the results. DELETE removes a letter and CLEAR empties the field.

    1. Hold BROWSE for a second
    2. Tap A
    3. Tap B
    4. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise

Tag list modern

The tag list is a quick list of tracks you want to play next. It holds up to 100 tracks and shows how many it has in the header. XZ Mods keeps it on the USB in XZMODS/playlists.txt, with your playlist changes. To add a track, use ADD TO TAG LIST in the MENU panel. To add a whole folder, highlight it and use ADD ALL TO TAG LIST.

    1. Press TAG LIST
    2. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise
    3. Press MENU
    4. Press BACK

Playlists modern

Tap PLAYLIST in the BROWSE category rail, or on the SHORTCUT screen, to open the USB's playlists. You can also make your own and change them on the player. Press MENU in the playlist list or inside a playlist.

    1. Press BROWSE
    2. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 6 clicks clockwise, then push it
    3. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise, then push it
    4. Press BACK
In the MENU panelWhat it does
NEW PLAYLISTMakes a playlist in the folder that is open. Type its name on the keyboard
RENAMERenames the highlighted playlist
DELETEDeletes the highlighted playlist. Push again to confirm
ADD TO PLAYLISTAdds the highlighted track to a playlist you pick
REMOVE FROM PLAYLISTTakes the highlighted track out of the playlist
MOVE TRACKPicks up a track. Turn the encoder to move it, push to drop it

Playlists, the tag list, played marks and histories can change only on a USB that is not read-only. Changes made on the player are saved on the same USB in XZMODS/playlists.txt. They never change the library your DJ software exported, so your DJ software and the CLASSIC browse screens do not show them. A playlist you changed on the player is marked in the list. In HISTORY the MENU panel offers DELETE HISTORY and DELETE ALL HISTORIES, each after a second push. If the USB is read-only you see THIS STICK IS READ-ONLY: PLAYLISTS CANNOT CHANGE. If it is full you see THE STICK IS FULL: PLAYLIST NOT SAVED.

SOURCE modern

SOURCE shows every place music can come from, one tile each. Press BACK at the top of a list, or tap the source tile at the top left of BROWSE.

    1. Open SOURCE (BACK at the top of a list)
    2. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise
    3. Press BACK

Turn the encoder to pick a tile and push to open it, or tap it. A source the player's own screen handles opens that screen. Touch cannot open it yet; push the encoder instead.

INFO modern

Press INFO on the play screen, or tap the INFO icon in the top bar, to see everything about a loaded track.

Browsing in CLASSIC classic

CLASSIC keeps the player's own browse screens: the same lists, keys and menus the XDJ-XZ operating instructions describe. XZ Mods adds three things to them.

  • The key in every row. Each track row shows up to three fields from the library exported to your USB inside the title cell. The default is the title, then the key, then the BPM.
  • Key before title. With KEY BEFORE TITLE on, the key leads the row, so you can read keys down the list.
  • Key match colours. With KEY MATCH COLOURS on, a leading key is green when it mixes with the master deck's key, amber when it is detuned against it, and grey otherwise.

The table header names what the player's own MENU click changes: SORT over the title column and COLUMN over the right-hand column. The STEMS and MODS buttons stay at the top right.

These additions only use tracks on a USB with an exported library. A track XZ Mods cannot match in the export keeps the player's own row, and a field the export does not have is left out.

Browse settings

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap SCREEN
    3. Tap KEY MATCH COLOURS
    4. Tap KEY BEFORE TITLE
    5. Tap CLOSE
    6. Press BROWSE
    7. Push ROTARY SELECTOR
    8. Press MENU
    9. Tap ARTIST
SettingMODSWhat it doesDefault
browse_previewPREVIEW tile in MODERN browseShows the preview waveform column in MODERN browseHidden
browse_trafficSCREEN, KEY MATCH COLOURSColours keys that mix with the master deck's key, in both interfacesOn
browse_key_prefixSCREEN, KEY BEFORE TITLEPuts the key first in each CLASSIC browse rowOn
browse_1, browse_2, browse_3noneThe three fields in each CLASSIC browse row, in order. Each is TITLE, ARTIST, KEY or BPMTITLE, KEY, BPM
modern_browse_columnsCOLUMNS in the MODERN MENU panelThe columns of the MODERN track list. TITLE always showsAutomatic

MODS has no control for the three CLASSIC row fields in this version. They keep the values stored on the USB. In MODERN, choose columns from the MENU panel instead.

If browsing goes wrong

    1. Open SOURCE (BACK at the top of a list)
    2. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise, then push it
    3. Press BROWSE
    4. Push ROTARY SELECTOR
    5. Press LOAD 1
You seeWhat to do
USB1 IS NOT CONNECTED or USB2 IS NOT CONNECTEDInsert the USB, or pick another source
USB SOURCE CHANGED: SELECT TRACK AGAINThe USB changed while you chose. Highlight the track again
LOAD FROM THIS LIST IS OFFLoad from a track list instead
LINK BROWSING IS NOT AVAILABLE YET or COMPUTER BROWSING IS NOT AVAILABLE YETSwitch to CLASSIC to browse that source
TOUCH CANNOT OPEN THIS YET: PUSH THE ENCODERHighlight the tile and push the encoder
PLAYLIST CHANGE NOT APPLIEDTry again. If the USB is read-only or full, the notice says so

connect.title: Connect and DJ profiles
connect.html:
CONNECT is the MODS section for people and computers: your DJ profile, the VJ.Tools link, the player's network and updates over the network. Everything here is optional. The player plays the same with all of it switched off.

Open MODS with MENU, then choose CONNECT in the section rail.

The CONNECT page

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap CONNECT
    3. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 3 clicks clockwise
    4. Press BACK

The HOME card for CONNECT shows your active DJ profile and its USB, then the state of the VJ.Tools link, for example DJ Kai (USB 1) | VJ.Tools waiting. With no profile it reads No DJ profile.

DJ profile

A DJ profile is your DJ name and logo, with an optional tagline. It lives on your USB, next to your music. VJ software such as VJ.Tools shows the profile of the USB that is playing on the master deck, so the screens behind you show who is playing. Nothing is stored on the XZ and nothing is uploaded.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap CONNECT
    3. Tap DJ PROFILE
    4. Tap SET UP DJ PROFILE
    5. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise

DJ Profile is an open standard. Any player, mixer or VJ program can read the same folder.

Make a profile on a computer

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap CONNECT
    3. Tap DJ PROFILE
    4. Tap SET UP DJ PROFILE
    5. Tap CHECK USB FOR PROFILES
    6. Press BACK
  1. On the USB, make a folder named DJPROFILE at the top level.
  2. Inside it, make a folder with your DJ name, for example DJPROFILE/DJ Kai.
  3. Put your logo in that folder as logo.png or logo.jpg.
  4. Put the USB in the XZ, open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE and push CHECK USB FOR PROFILES.

A folder with a usable logo is a profile. A folder without one is skipped. A USB shows at most 16 profiles. The XZ Mods app can also make and edit profiles. See The XZ Mods app.

Make a profile on the XZ

You can type a profile on the player with the encoder or by touch.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap CONNECT
    3. Tap DJ PROFILE
    4. Tap SET UP DJ PROFILE
    5. Tap CREATE ON THIS XZ
    6. Type dj test on the screen keyboard
    7. Tap NEXT: LOGO
    8. Tap NO LOGO
    9. Tap NEXT: TAGLINE
    10. Type fixture set on the screen keyboard
    11. Tap NEXT: REVIEW
    12. Tap SAVE TO USB 1
    13. Tap NEW PROFILE
    14. Type dj two on the screen keyboard
    15. Tap NEXT: LOGO
    16. Tap NO LOGO
    17. Tap NEXT: TAGLINE
    18. Tap SKIP TAGLINE
    19. Tap SAVE TO USB 1
    20. Tap < PREV
    21. Tap MAKE ACTIVE
  1. Open CONNECT › DJ PROFILE.
  2. Push CREATE ON THIS XZ, or NEW PROFILE if the USB already has one.
  3. Type your DJ name on the on-screen keyboard, then push NEXT: LOGO.
  4. Pick a PNG or JPEG image from the USB, or NO LOGO. Images in your own DJPROFILE folder are listed first. Then push NEXT: TAGLINE.
  5. Type a few words, such as your genre, city or crew, and push NEXT: REVIEW. To leave the tagline out, push SKIP TAGLINE.
  6. Check the review, then push SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2.

A new profile becomes the active profile on the USB you save it to. Only the DJPROFILE folder on that USB is written. Your music, playlists and stems are not touched.

StepControls
Name and taglineThe keyboard, SHIFT for capitals, #+= for symbols (ABC goes back), SPACE, DELETE, BACK to the step before
LogoOne row per image on the USB, PREV and NEXT for more, RESCAN (or CHECK USB AGAIN), NO LOGO, KEEP CURRENT when you edit
ReviewCHANGE NAME, CHANGE LOGO, CHANGE TAGLINE, then SAVE TO USB 1 or SAVE TO USB 2
  • A name holds up to 64 characters and a tagline up to 80.
  • With NO LOGO, your initial is shown on the accent colour.
  • Logos are shown square over black.
  • Nothing is saved until you push SAVE. The bottom line says NOTHING IS SAVED UNTIL YOU PRESS SAVE on the review step.

Choose and switch profiles

With profiles on the USB, the DJ PROFILE page shows one profile at a time: its logo, name and tagline, which USB it is on, and whether it is active there.

Control or lineWhat it means
< PREV, NEXT >Step through the profiles on both USBs. 2 OF 3 shows where you are
EDITChange this profile's name, logo or tagline
MAKE ACTIVEMakes this the active profile on its USB. Only the USB is written
NEW PROFILEMakes another profile on the USB, for an alias or a back to back set
CHECK USBReads both USB ports again
ACTIVE ON THIS USBThis profile is the one its USB says is playing
SHOWN TO THE VJ NOWThis is the profile VJ software sees right now
FROM ITS FOLDER IN DJPROFILEA profile made from a folder and a logo
OLDER CARD: EDIT IT IN VJ.TOOLSAn older profile card. Edit it in VJ.Tools, or make a new profile

Your active profile also sits in the MODS header, with its logo and name. Tap it, or highlight it and push, to switch between the profiles on both USBs.

Note

The player's own saved settings are MY SETTINGS in UTILITY. They are separate from your DJ profile.

When a profile will not save or show

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap CONNECT
    3. Tap DJ PROFILE
    4. Tap SET UP DJ PROFILE
    5. Tap CREATE ON THIS XZ
    6. Type dj test on the screen keyboard
    7. Tap NEXT: LOGO
    8. Tap pictures/alternate.jpg
    9. Tap NEXT: TAGLINE
    10. Tap SKIP TAGLINE
    11. Tap SAVE TO USB 1
    12. Tap CHANGE LOGO
    13. Tap NO LOGO
    14. Tap NEXT: TAGLINE
    15. Tap SKIP TAGLINE
    16. Tap SAVE TO USB 1
MessageWhat to do
INSERT THE USB WITH YOUR MUSICPut your USB in. Profiles live on the USB only
NO DJ PROFILE ON THIS USB YETMake one on a computer or on the XZ, as above
INSERT A USB FIRSTInsert a USB before you push CREATE ON THIS XZ
TYPE YOUR DJ NAME FIRSTThe name cannot be empty
THE NAME IS FULL, THE TAGLINE IS FULLYou reached 64 or 80 characters
THAT USB IS NOT IN / PUT IT BACKPut the USB back in the port you are saving to
THIS LOGO CANNOT BE USED / CHANGE LOGOPick another image, or NO LOGO
THIS PROFILE FILE IS DAMAGED / SAVE IT AGAIN FROM VJ.TOOLSSave the profile again from VJ.Tools or the XZ Mods app
SAVING YOUR PROFILE TO THE USB / KEEP THE USB INWait. Do not pull the USB

VJ.Tools experimental

VJ.Tools is a desktop app for VJs. The VJ.TOOLS page lets VJ.Tools on a computer connect to the player, announces the player on the network, and can show the computer's picture instead of the play screen.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap CONNECT
    3. Tap VJ.TOOLS
    4. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise
ControlChoicesWhat it does
VJ.TOOLS VIEWON, OFFON shows the computer's VJ.Tools screen on the player. OFF shows the play screen
SCREEN SWITCH KEYLINK, ONSCREENLINK makes the LINK key switch the view. ONSCREEN puts a button for it on the screen. See Controls on the player
VJ.TOOLS CONNECTIONON, OFFLets VJ.Tools connect
DISCOVERABLEON, OFFLets VJ.Tools find the player without typing its address

When a link control shows READ ONLY, MODS cannot change it on this player. Pushing it shows CONTROL IS NOT AVAILABLE.

To switch the view without opening MODS, use the key you chose under SCREEN SWITCH KEY. You can also give the button above LINK the job VJ.TOOLS SCREEN in PLAY › BUTTON ABOVE LINK. It needs an enabled, connected VJ.Tools link, and says so when there is none. In CLASSIC, a VJ.TOOLS button can appear on the top bar. It reads EXIT VJ while the view is on.

Experimental

The VJ.Tools view has shown video on the player during development. Long playback and touch while the view is on have not been accepted yet. Keep it off during a set unless you have tested it.

Network experimental

NETWORK sets up the player's network adapters for VJ.Tools and network updates. You do not need it to play.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap CONNECT
    3. Tap NETWORK
    4. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise

Setup runs in four steps. Every change lasts until the player is switched off.

  1. Detect. The page lists each adapter with its link state and current address.
  2. Choose. Pick an adapter and how it gets an address: KEEP CURRENT, DHCP ON or STATIC IP. With STATIC IP, use EDIT IP, EDIT MASK / PREFIX and EDIT GATEWAY. PRIORITY UP and PRIORITY DOWN set which adapter XZ Mods prefers.
  3. Review. Push REVIEW CHANGES and read the summary.
  4. Apply. Push APPLY FOR THIS BOOT. The page then checks the result. REVERT TRIAL / MODS DHCP OFF undoes what this setup added.
MessageWhat to do
DETECT ACTUAL ADAPTERS FIRSTPush DETECT ADAPTERS AGAIN, then choose
ENTER A VALID IP AND CONTIGUOUS MASK / PREFIXCheck the address and mask you typed
ENTER A VALID GATEWAY OR KEEP ROUTE OFFType a valid gateway, or set MODS ROUTE: OFF
NETWORK CHANGED / DETECT AND CHOOSE AGAINA cable or adapter changed. Start the setup again
RELOAD A PRIVATE USB IMAGE WITH NETWORK SUPPORTThis USB loader has no network support. Update the loader with the XZ Mods app, then push VERIFY RELOADED LOADER
Experimental

The NETWORK pages still use technical wording and may change. Your changes never outlive a power cycle, so switching the player off and on always brings back its own network setup.

Updates over the network experimental

UPDATES fetches a newer signed XZ Mods runtime from the XZ Mods app on your computer and saves it to the USB. The update starts at the next power cycle. Your music stays where it is.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap CONNECT
    3. Tap UPDATES
    4. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise
  1. Prepare the USB with a current XZ Mods app, so the loader supports network updates.
  2. In the XZ Mods app, start network updates. See The XZ Mods app.
  3. Connect the XZ to the same network as the computer. Use NETWORK if it needs an address.
  4. Open CONNECT › UPDATES › SET UP NETWORK UPDATES and push DETECT UPDATE SERVER.
  5. Back on UPDATES, push DOWNLOAD UPDATE.
  6. Switch the player off and on to start the new version.
Caution

Never switch the player off while the update is being written to the USB, and never update during a set.

To undo an update, push PREVIOUS VERSION and switch the player off and on. Network updates change XZ Mods only. If the player will not start XZ Mods at all, restore or update the USB loader with the XZ Mods app.

desktop-app.title: The XZ Mods app
desktop-app.html:
The XZ Mods app runs on your computer. It puts XZ Mods on a USB, makes stems for your tracks, makes your DJ profile, keeps the app and your USB up to date, holds tools for your library, games and the XZ screen, and sends your reports and ideas to the maintainer. It never formats a drive and never changes your music or the library your DJ software exported.

You need 64-bit Windows with WebView2, or a Mac with macOS 14 or later. Making stems needs a Windows computer or an Apple silicon Mac. On an Intel Mac you can still import stems you made elsewhere.

Around the app

The bar along the top has five sections for your work, then the Manual and About and, on the right, Feedback. The section you are in is filled yellow. The page sits on the raised panel below it.

SectionWhat it is for
USBInstall or update XZ Mods on a USB, add your DJ profile and games
StemsMake stems for the tracks on your music USB, or import stems you already have
DJ ProfileYour name and logo on the XZ, and the profile track
UpdatesApp updates, the XZ Mods version for your USB, and network updates for your XZ
ToolsRepair library, Game downloads and XZ Screen
ManualThis manual, with search, animations and your place in it
AboutThe app, its maker, links, disclaimers and open-source licenses
FeedbackReport a problem, request a feature or ask a question, and follow what you sent

Tools, Updates and the Manual list what they hold down the left, beside the page: the tools, the three Updates pages, or the manual's chapters. The button at the far left of the top bar hides that list and shows it again, and the app remembers your choice.

The top left names the player firmware the app prepares USBs for, XDJ-XZ 1.26. The app version is at the top right. In a narrower window point at Preview to see it.

The app opens as large as its pages need, but never larger than your screen. In a narrow window the sections show only their icons. Point at one to see its name. The list on the left then opens over the page from the button at the top left, and closes when you pick something.

USB

USB is the first page. Plug in your XZ USB, or any USB stick, and the app finds it. When only one USB is connected, it opens by itself.

Choose a USB or a folder

The USB list shows every connected USB the app can write XZ Mods to. Any file system works, FAT32 or exFAT, and each card shows it beside the drive letter. Choose a card to open that USB.

Write to a folder instead… puts the loader and its settings in a folder on this computer. Copy everything in it to the top of a USB stick afterward. Games are added only when you write to a USB itself.

The list comes back whenever you step back from a USB: Change USB on the dashboard, Cancel in a guide, or Esc on the dashboard. The USB you left does not open by itself again until you plug in or remove a drive, so you can pick another one. Its card is still selected, and Enter opens it again.

The USB dashboard

Once a USB is open, the page shows one status and one action for it.

The status changes with what the app finds:

StatusActionWhat it means
XZ Mods is not on this USB yetInstall XZ ModsAdds the loader, free games and your DJ profile. Music and playlists stay as they are.
Update availableUpdate USBThe USB has an older build. Updating backs up its loader first. See what changes lists what is new.
Up to datenoneThe chosen build is already on this USB.
Choose which XZ Mods build goes on this USBUse the newest buildNo build is chosen on this computer yet. The button picks the one that came with the app.
No XZ Mods build is on this computer yetSet up mod versionsOpens a short guide that finds or imports a build.

Install or update XZ Mods

Install XZ Mods and Update USB open a short guide. The steps that do not apply are left out, so the count at the top changes.

Every step ends in the same bar. Back on the left returns to the step before; from the first step it returns to the dashboard. The way forward is on the right. Esc does the same as Back. Cancel at the top leaves the guide without writing anything and shows the USB list, so you can choose another USB or a folder. While the USB is written there is no Back, and the done screen has Done instead, because a write cannot be undone.

  1. Your DJ profile. Appears when the USB has no profile yet. Type your name and add a logo, or choose Skip for now and add it later.
  2. Choose the screen the XZ shows. New interface (MODERN) or Standard XDJ-XZ interface (CLASSIC). See Getting started.
  3. Ready to write. A checklist of everything the write will do.
  4. Writing. The progress of each part. Underneath, the app explains four decks while you wait.
  5. Done. What was written, what to do on the XZ, and how four decks work.
  6. Optional support. A thank-you page with a voluntary support link. Every feature works whether you contribute or not.

Four decks is not a step of the guide. Nothing about it happens while the USB is written: you set it up at the player, whenever you want. See Four decks in the app.

Note

The two small pictures under the cards show an older version of the MODS menu. On the player, INTERFACE is on the SCREEN page.

Beat Arcade, Wave Rider, Rhythm Lab and Static Surfer are built into the loader and always come with it. Doom shareware, Chex Quest and Freedoom Phase 2 are free downloads that the app checks and copies to VJTOOLS\Games on the USB. A fresh USB gets every free game unless you untick it. An update keeps the games the USB already has and adds none on its own. Under the checklist, Eject the USB when writing finishes ejects it for you so you can take it straight to the XZ.

Press Write to USB in the bar under the checklist. If a newer build needs a setting changed on the USB, the app first asks in Adjust USB settings for this version. It saves a copy of the settings file first and puts it back if the loader write fails.

Under Four decks, Support XZ Mods (optional) opens the optional support page, and Eject the USB by itself next time ejects the USB on its own after the next write.

If a game download failed, Retry the failed games tries only those, and the USB is not ejected until you have. When the write also saved a DJ profile, Make the profile track opens the profile track steps.

Four decks in the app experimental

Four decks is set up at the player, so the app explains it rather than asking you to do anything. The USB list and the dashboard show a Four decks row. While a USB is written, and again on the done screen, a Four decks section shows the cable animation and the three things to do at the player.

How four decks work and the Four decks row both open the Four decks chapter of this manual. If the build just written has no four-deck engine, the section says so and offers Choose the four-deck build, which opens the four-deck build choice in XZ Mods version. Save it, then update the USB.

Stems

Stems makes vocal, harmonic and drum stems for the tracks on your music USB and writes them beside each track. Plug in the USB your DJ software exports your music to. The app lists every track on it. Your tracks and the library your DJ software exported stay as they are.

StatusWhat it meansWhat to do
ReadyStems are on the USBNothing. Open the details to Verify them
MissingNo stems yetSelect it and prepare
Not yetXZ Mods cannot prepare this format yet, such as AIFFExport the track as WAV, FLAC or MP3
No audio fileThe track's file is not on the USBExport the track to the USB again from your DJ software
FailedPreparing stopped, with the reason under itFix the reason, then Retry
DamagedVerify found a broken stem pageSelect it and prepare it again
Prepare againMade by an older versionOpen the details and choose Prepare again

A batch holds up to 100 tracks. The estimate turns amber when space gets tight and red when the selection does not fit. The button then reads Prepare N that fit and prepares the tracks in order until the next one would not fit.

While a batch runs, each row moves from Queued to Preparing to Ready, and the bar shows the track, the step and about how long is left. The first time on a new computer it says Timing this computer until it has measured. Cancel stops within a second. Finished tracks are kept. When the batch ends, the bar offers the next step.

After a batchWhat it offers
A track failedRetry N failed
You pressed CancelPrepare N remaining
The USB was unpluggedContinue. Nothing is left half-written
The USB filled upChoose fewer tracks

Open a row for its details. A Ready track shows who prepared it and offers Verify, which reads every stem page without changing the USB, Import stems to replace them, and Prepare again. Prepare again keeps the current stems until the new ones pass their check.

Set up the stem engine

The first time, the button reads Set up stem engine. It opens a short guide that ends on a working engine.

  1. Check. The app looks at this computer's graphics card or processor.
  2. Choose. Pick a quality. The recommended one is marked for this computer.
  3. Install. The app downloads what the engine needs once and checks every file.
  4. Test. It separates 30 seconds of your first selected track and tells you how long a whole track will take. Nothing is written to the USB.
QualityUse it for
BalancedThe best quality. Recommended with a graphics card or Apple silicon
FastGood separation in about half the time. Recommended without a graphics card
LightComputers without a graphics card and with little memory. Vocals bleed more

If setup cannot finish, it names the one reason and offers the fix. For example, when the graphics driver is too old, Use the processor sets up the engine on the processor instead.

Import stems you already have

Choose Import stems in the toolbar, or Import stems made elsewhere in a track's details. Drop stem files or a ZIP into the window, or choose files. WAV, FLAC, MP3 and AIFF sets work.

  1. Add files. From the toolbar, also pick which track the stems are for.
  2. Check. The app places each file on VOCALS, DRUMS or HARMONICS by its name and lines the stems up with the track on your USB. Change any Goes to choice you disagree with. Leave out skips a file.
  3. Write. Write stems to USB writes the stems and checks them.

A vocals and instrumental pair needs the stem engine to pull the drums out of the instrumental. If the engine is not set up yet, the import offers Set up stem engine and carries on afterward. To use stems on the player, see Stems.

DJ Profile

DJ Profile makes and edits the profiles on a USB. A profile is your name, logo and colour. The XZ shows each profile as a logo tile, and the active one is the DJ the XZ and VJ software on the same network see. Profiles are saved on the USB only. Nothing is uploaded. To use them on the player, see Connect and DJ profiles.

Some newer players block reading extra files from the USB. A profile track is a silent song that carries your name, logos and links, so it reaches them through your DJ software like any other track.

Updates

Updates keeps every version in one place, on three pages listed on the left: App updates for this app, XZ Mods version for the build that goes on your USB, and Network updates to send that build to XZs on your network. Updates opens on App updates. A yellow dot on Updates and on App updates in its list means a newer app is ready.

App updates

On Windows the app checks for updates by itself at launch and shows Review update at the top of the page when one is ready. The installer updates the app and opens it again. Mac versions download from the release page.

Caution

Updating the app does not change the loader on your USB. Open the USB page afterward and choose Update USB.

XZ Mods version

XZ Mods version chooses which build goes on your USB the next time you install or update it. Saving your choice does not write to any USB.

Lower on the page:

  • Restore or update a loader by hand updates the loader on a USB you choose and keeps a backup of the old one. Music and saved settings stay in place.
  • Prepare from a downloaded firmware file builds a loader from an official XDJ-XZ 1.26 firmware file into a folder you choose.

Import a build takes a prepared XZ Mods resources folder, or a whole XZ Mods app folder that holds one. The app checks every file before it adds the build. Imported builds are not checked on a real XDJ-XZ.

Network updates experimental

Network updates sends the build installed on this computer to XZs on your local network. Each XZ checks the signed update, saves it on its USB and starts it at the next boot.

  1. Prepare or update the USB loader once, so it supports network updates.
  2. Choose Detect adapters, then the adapter connected to the XZ network.
  3. Choose Start update server.
  4. On the XZ, open CONNECT › UPDATES, then download the update. See Updates over the network.
  5. Switch the XZ off and on when you are ready to start the new version.

Network updates change XZ Mods and the game engine. They keep your music and the original USB loader, so you can always go back. Cancel stops the server.

Note

The app's step 3 still says MODS › Extras › Network updates. On the player the page is CONNECT › UPDATES.

Tools

Tools holds what you need now and then, grouped by what it works on: your USB and your XZ. The list on the left holds the same tools, so you can go straight from one to another. Tools in the top left of each tool goes back to this page.

Repair library

Repair library checks the music library your DJ software exported to a USB the XZ cannot read. It can clear invalid unused pages and reconnect playback history pages that survived. It keeps track records, playlists, music and prepared stems.

  1. Choose the USB. Then choose Check library.
  2. Library check. The verdict, what the library holds and what is wrong. Save report keeps the result on this computer.
  3. Repair plan. What changes and what stays the same. Back up and repair backs up the library files first.

If the DJ software that writes the USB is open on this computer, the check says so and offers Prepare for repair. Close it so both apps do not write at the same time, then check again. After a repair, Undo this repair puts the library files back exactly as they were before it.

Game downloads

Game downloads gets the free games again and copies them to a USB. Use it to retry a download that failed while the app wrote your USB, or to add the games to a USB that already has XZ Mods. Games already on the USB stay in place.

Doom shareware, Chex Quest and Freedoom Phase 2 each have their own download. Put your own compatible WADs in a WADS folder on either USB, then choose a base game and an optional add-on in the XZ's USB WAD loader. Downloading games does not change the XZ loader.

XZ Screen experimental

XZ Screen shows the XDJ-XZ screen on this computer over the network, so you can add it to an OBS scene. It sends the picture only, no audio, and the XZ keeps all its controls.

  1. Connect this computer and the XZ to the same network, for example the same router or a network cable between them.
  2. Choose Set up Live Streamer. The app looks for the XZ at once.
  3. If the guide asks, update the USB loader on the USB page, then switch the XZ off and on with both decks stopped. The guide never restarts the XZ.
  4. Choose Connect.

To use the picture in OBS, add a Browser source, paste the OBS Browser Source URL, and set its width to 800 and height to 480. Copy OBS URL copies it. Keep the app running. The URL works on this computer only and changes when you reconnect.

Tick Show a logo while browsing USB to cover the stream with the XZ Mods logo while you browse your USB. The play screen comes back on its own. Menus, custom themes and screens the app does not recognise stay covered.

With an older USB loader the picture updates about once a second and the status says it is not performance video. Update the USB loader appears beside it.

Manual

Manual is this manual, inside the app. It comes with the app, so it needs no internet connection. Where the app explains a feature, Read in the manual opens the chapter about it.

  • How-to videos. Many sections show how to get there on the player: the player's screen, beside a true-scale picture of the key, rotary selector or pad you use, pressed in time with the screen. The steps under the video light up as it reaches them. Click a step to play from there. Where a section shows more than one way, the tabs above the steps switch between them.
  • Numbers on pictures. Point at a number, or tab to it and use the arrow keys, to light up that part of the picture and read what it is. Play steps through every number. The list under the picture says the same.
  • Your interface. Choose MODERN, CLASSIC or Both on the start page or at the foot of the chapter list. The manual then hides what does not apply to you. A MODS page drawn in both interfaces has a MODERN and CLASSIC switch on its picture.
  • Where you stopped. The manual remembers the chapter and section you read last. The start page offers Continue where you left off.
  • Less motion. When your computer is set to reduce motion, nothing in the manual moves by itself. A video shows a still picture of each step and plays only when you press Play.

The menu map

Menu map, under the start page in the chapter list, shows every screen on the player and how to get to it, as a flow chart. The play screen is on the left, and what each key opens fans out to its right. Every branch is labelled with the control that opens it: a key such as MENU, the rotary selector, or a tap on a word on the screen.

  • Room to work. The chapter list folds away while the map is open, so the map has the width. The button at the far left of the top bar brings the list back.
  • Move around. Drag the map to move it. The mouse wheel, or the + and − keys on your computer, zoom in and out, and 0 fits the whole map. In a wide window the small map in the corner shows where you are; click it to go there.
  • Branches. The number beside a screen opens the screens after it, and − closes them again. The map opens with the MODS sections closed, so the first view stays readable.
  • Keys. The arrow keys walk the map: right into a branch, left back out, up and down to the screens beside it. Enter opens a screen and Esc closes it. Previous screen and Next screen at the foot of a screen walk the whole map in order.
  • From a chapter. A section of the manual about a screen has On the menu map beside its heading. It opens the map at that screen.

About

About says what XZ Mods is and who makes it, and gathers the links, the disclaimers and the open-source licenses in one place.

Feedback

Feedback is where you tell the maintainer about a problem, ask for a feature or ask a question, and follow what you sent. It sits at the right of the top bar on every page.

Reports from your XZ that wait for your words appear above My reports, under From your XZ. The sticks that may send them are listed under Your XZ sticks.

Report a problem or share an idea

The report window sends a private report to the maintainer: a problem, something that got worse, an idea or a question. Report a problem in Feedback opens it at the first question. Request a feature and Ask a question answer that question for you. The only thing you have to fill in is one box. Nothing is posted publicly.

  1. Pick what it is about, or Not sure.
  2. Answer at most two more short questions, or press Not sure.
  3. Write what happened in your own words. One sentence is enough.
  4. Press Send privately.
You pickIt then asks
Something got worseWhen it got worse, then for the USB sticks that were in the XZ
Something isn't workingWhat kind of problem: sound, SYNC or tempo, the screen, buttons and pads, loading and USB, four decks, a crash, or something else
It should work differentlyCompared with what: the XZ before XZ Mods, another XZ feature, other DJ gear or software, an earlier XZ Mods version, or just your preference. For gear or another feature, which one
I have a new ideaWhat kind of idea
How do I...?Nothing more. Go straight to your question

As you type, Is this it? shows answers from this manual. The matching runs on your computer; your words are not sent anywhere for it. If an answer solves it, its button opens the right setup, such as Set up four decks, or That answers it closes the window. Nothing is sent.

Included details

While you answer and type, the app reads the details that help the maintainer, for at most 10 seconds: the session log and settings on your XZ Mods USB, the diary on each stick, the app's events and the build. Everything is cleaned first. No track names, file paths, serial numbers or network addresses are kept.

Send privately sends exactly your words and the ticked details shown at that moment. If you send before the app has finished reading, it sends what it has read and notes what is missing. Collect again reads everything again. Ideas include no details at all, only your words. Details are deleted after 14 days.

When something got worse

For something that got worse, the app asks you to plug in every USB stick that was in the XZ when it happened. XZ Mods versions that keep a diary write it to each stick while the XZ plays. The app reads only that diary, never your music.

Each stick appears by itself as you plug it in. Press That's all of them when every stick is in. A missing stick or a missing diary never stops you sending.

After you send

Every accepted report or idea gets its own reference, such as R-4F7K-2M9Q. Quote it when asking about that report. Copy copies the reference. The reference stays the same if you send again after a connection failure. It does not let anyone read your report or its status.

If the app cannot confirm that a report arrived, it says Not confirmed yet. Nothing is lost. Set up reporting connection checks the internet connection and the computer's clock, then Send again sends the same report. If the first attempt did arrive, you get its receipt and nothing arrives twice. Save to a file keeps a copy without sending.

My reports

My reports lists every report and idea sent from this computer, with its kind and where it is now, in plain words. It is the list under the buttons in Feedback.

When a report's status changes, a notice appears at the top of whichever page is open.

The app checks for news when it starts, after it checks for app updates, and when you open My reports, at most every 15 minutes for each report. Check now checks at once. If you are offline, the last known status stays.

Open a report to see where it is. The view is read-only. Once the maintainer assigns it, Part of XZ-1042 names the bug, feature or question it belongs to. Reports about the same item share that item number. If the maintainer moves your report to another item, this number changes; your R reference stays the same. Item numbers remain after the report's details are deleted.

  • If the maintainer needs one more detail, the question appears in the report. Answer in a new report starts a report that names this one.
  • Open status page and Copy status link give a read-only web page with the same status, report reference and item number. It shows none of your words or details. Anyone with the link can read the status. Turn off status links stops every link for this report; the app still checks it.
  • Forget this report removes its receipt from this computer. The maintainer keeps the report.
  • A report saved, but not sent, by an older version of the app appears under Saved, not sent. Use this text starts a new report with its words.

Details are deleted 14 days after you send them. Tracking lasts while a report is open, up to one year without news, then 180 days after it closes. A fix in a local test build is not a published update.

From your XZ

A report sent from the XZ waits in Feedback for your words. From your XZ appears above My reports while one waits. The XZ notes the screen you were on as names only. It keeps no picture and no text from the screen.

  • Send adds your words to the same report, under the same reference. The report then moves to your sent reports, where you follow it like any other.
  • Send without comments finishes the report as it is.
  • If the app can't reach the report service, it keeps your words and sends them by itself later. You can close the app.
  • The XZ already sent the collected details. They are deleted 14 days after it sent them. After that the report says so, and your words still reach the maintainer.
  • The maintainer sees the report as soon as the XZ sends it, marked as waiting for your comments, and can start from the logs.

The app tells you when a report from the XZ waits:

  • While the app is open, a new report brings a Windows notification, such as "Your XZ sent a report, R-4F7K-2M9Q. Add what happened?" Click it to open that report.
  • Feedback in the top bar shows how many reports wait.
  • When the app starts with reports waiting, a callout under the page title names them.

Reminders end when you choose Stop reminding, or 7 days after a report arrives. Each report brings one notification at most. If Windows notifications are off for XZ Mods, or your copy of the app is not installed, the badge and the callout tell you instead.

Your XZ sticks

Every stick XZ Mods writes gets a loader ID, such as L-7K2M-9Q4F. It lets the XZ send reports from that stick to this computer, and to nothing else. Your XZ sticks, near the bottom of Feedback, lists them.

  • Revoke a stick you lost or gave away. The XZ can no longer send reports from it. If you are offline, the stick is revoked on this computer at once and the report service hears of it later.
  • Writing XZ Mods to that stick again gives it a new key, and it can send reports again.
  • Plug it in to finish means a write to that stick was not confirmed. Plug the stick in with the app open. If the state stays, write XZ Mods to the stick again.
  • With no sticks yet, Set up a USB opens the USB setup.

Maintainer inbox

Maintainer inbox, at the bottom of Feedback, is for the maintainer. Connect it with the report-only owner key. The short setup checks that key by reading the inbox.

Enter a report reference or item number in the search box and choose Find. You can type either case, with or without spaces and dashes. For a report reference, I or L also means 1, and O means 0. A report reference finds one report; an item number finds the reports assigned to that item. Clear returns to the inbox.

The reference and item number identify a report; the owner key is still required to read the inbox.

Desktop language

Choose Language / Idioma below the navigation to open XZ language setup. It detects the bundled offline catalogs, lets you choose a language, imports an optional JSON catalog, then applies the text so you can verify it on screen. No account or translation service is required. This setting belongs to XZ Mods only.

Coverage counts describe extracted desktop and manual text. Machine translations require language review. Export a catalog to review text offline; import rejects changed sources, missing placeholders and altered printed control names. After a source change, regenerate all languages against a fresh source snapshot.

For local generation, open the independent provider section. Detect saved resources, enter the Python executable and Small100 model folder, then choose Connect and live verify. The test translates a sentence into all 14 languages. Install pinned dependencies creates an XZ-only Python environment using the selected Python and installs the pinned provider packages. It needs network access for those packages, but translation runs locally without credentials or paid services. The Small100 folder must already contain model.bin, shared_vocabulary.json and sentencepiece.bpe.model.

Choose Generate all languages to resume the full corpus. Progress and logs remain in the XZ application data directory. Cancel translation stops this job and retains checkpoints. Publication replaces the complete language set only after every locale passes structural validation. This does not establish native-speaker approval. The packaged source snapshot belongs to this XZ release; updating the app supplies a new snapshot.

Printed hardware names such as CUE, SHIFT, SYNC, MENU and BACK stay as printed. Track names and stock alerts are not translated. Arabic uses browser right-to-left text layout; fonts come from the operating system. Controller screenshots keep their original labels. Controller mod text still needs Unicode font and layout integration; choosing a desktop language does not change it.

extras.title: Extras
extras.html:
EXTRAS holds what is not about playing a set: games, apps from a USB, reporting a problem and the About page. Nothing here starts on its own. The XZ always starts in its normal DJ view, and a game or app opens only when you choose it.

Open MODS with MENU, then choose EXTRAS in the section rail.

The EXTRAS page

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap EXTRAS
    3. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 3 clicks clockwise
    4. Press BACK

The HOME card for EXTRAS counts the games and the apps found on your USBs, for example 6 games | no USB apps.

Games

Every game runs on the XZ itself. The music keeps playing while you play, and PLAY and track search keep their normal jobs in Beat Arcade. Doom and Beat Arcade make no sound of their own.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap EXTRAS
    3. Tap GAMES
    4. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise
GameWhat it isNeeds
Beat Arcade experimentalSolo Pong, Pong Duel on both jogs, Solo Breaks and a two-player Breakout. Tap CUE on the beat to build chargeNothing. Built in
Wave Rider experimentalThe loaded track's waveform becomes hills. Steer with the jog, hold CUE to add weight. Solo, Co-op or VersusNothing. Built in
Rhythm LabTen short rhythm studies for the jogs and pads. They are prototypes, and you can rate each oneNothing. Built in
Static SurferA rhythm platformer. Tap to jump and tilt the jog to pass through the glyphsNothing. Built in
DoomClassic Doom or Doom IIGame files on the USB
Chex QuestThe original Chex QuestGame files on the USB

Moving around a game

You do not need the touchscreen in any game.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap EXTRAS
    3. Tap GAMES
    4. Tap WAVE RIDER
    5. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise, then push it
    6. Push ROTARY SELECTOR
    7. Push ROTARY SELECTOR
    8. Turn the left jog wheel
    9. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise, then push it
    10. Press CUE on the left deck
    11. Turn the left jog wheel
    12. Tap the screen
ControlIn a game
Turn the encoderMoves a ring over the controls on the screen
Push the encoderPresses the control under the ring
BACKSteps back
TouchPresses what you touch. The ring hides until you turn the encoder again

Beat Arcade experimental

Turn the jog to move your paddle and tap CUE on each beat as the moving light meets the target. Good notes build charge. Eight good notes in a row earn a shield, and sixteen build a Drop that fires on the next downbeat.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap EXTRAS
    3. Tap GAMES
    4. Tap BEAT ARCADE
    5. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise, then push it
    6. Turn the left jog wheel
    7. Press CUE on the left deck
    8. Press pad G on the left deck
    9. Tap the screen
    10. Tap the screen
ControlAction
JogMoves the paddle. In the menu, chooses a game
CUE or pad AStrikes on the beat. Starts, resumes and rematches
Pad BWide paddle for 16 beats
Pad CSaves one miss with a shield
Pad DQueues a Drop on the next downbeat
Pads E and FAim the next return
Pad GChanges the scene between Tunnel, Grid and Orbit
Pad HLines up with the mixer tempo, or taps a tempo
PLAY, track searchWork as usual on the music
DJ VIEW on screenSaves the round and gives every control back to the deck

Tap the source display at the top of the game to choose where the beat comes from: an analysed USB track, Pro DJ Link, the mixer tempo or four taps on pad H. For mixer tempo, set Beat FX to the channel you play, usually MASTER, and use AUTO BPM.

While Beat Arcade runs, touching the platter does not pause or scratch the music. Choose DJ VIEW before you go back to mixing.

Wave Rider experimental

Choose Solo, Co-op or Versus, then the deck whose track you ride. In Solo that deck's jog steers. With two players, the left jog is player 1 and the right jog is player 2.

  • Hold CUE or a top-row pad to add weight and gain speed downhill. Let go as the ground rises, and the crest throws you into the air.
  • Turn the jog to tilt the board. Clockwise points the nose down.
  • Land with the slope to keep your speed. Clean landings in a row score more.
  • EASY is the default and keeps the angle you set in the air. NORMAL and HARD are stricter.

A missed landing never stops the music.

Doom and Chex Quest

Doom and Chex Quest need game files on the USB. The XZ Mods app can download and check free Doom shareware, Chex Quest and Freedoom data when you prepare the USB. For the full Doom or Doom II you supply your own files. See The XZ Mods app.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap EXTRAS
    3. Tap GAMES
    4. Tap USB WAD LOADER
    5. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise
Player controlIn Doom
JogTurn left or right
PLAY, or pad AWalk forward
Pad BWalk back
CUE, or pad CShoot
Pad DUse, for example open a door
Pads E and FStrafe
Pad GEnter
Pad H, or BACKGame menu
Turn and push the encoderMoves through the game menu and enters

To end the game, touch EXIT. The player goes back to the screen you had before.

If the list says PUT .WAD FILES ON USB, THEN RESCAN, copy the files to the USB on a computer, put it back and push RESCAN USB.

My House experimental

My House is a Doom mod that needs the GZDoom engine. The MY HOUSE page checks for that engine and the files, but the classic Doom engine cannot load this mod, and the XZ Mods app no longer copies it to the USB.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap EXTRAS
    3. Tap GAMES
    4. Tap MY HOUSE / SETUP
    5. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise

USB apps experimental

USB APPS runs apps built with the XZ SDK from a USB. DJ controls keep working while an app runs.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap EXTRAS
    3. Tap USB APPS
    4. Tap SET UP APPS
    5. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise

Put apps on a USB in VJ.Tools/XZ-SDK/Applications. Apps in VJ.Tools/XZ-SDK/Autoload start on their own when AUTOLOAD is on.

Each app row shows what kind of package it is and its state.

StateMeaning
RUNNING ON SCREENAn app is showing on the player
RUNNING IN BACKGROUNDA service is running
APPLIEDA profile package is in use
FAILEDThe app stopped. Push RUN AGAIN
BLOCKEDThe package cannot run. Push SET UP to see how to fix it
CHECKINGThe app manager is still reading the package
  1. Detect. Finds the app manager and any apps on the USB.
  2. Folders. Choose START WHEN I TAP RUN or START ON USB INSERT.
  3. Install. Copy apps to the USB. The page shows the packer command for the desktop.
  4. Live test. Push RUN TEST APP. When it shows, push IT WORKS.
Note

APP MANAGER NOT RUNNING means XZ Mods did not start it. Switch the XZ off, start it again with its XZ Mods USB in, then push CHECK AGAIN.

Report an issue

REPORT AN ISSUE sends the maintainer a problem, a question or an idea from the player. You say what it is about and, if you like, what happened. The player adds its own details. A topic and SEND take three presses.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap EXTRAS
    3. Tap REPORT AN ISSUE
    4. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR to SOMETHING ISN'T WORKING and push it
    5. Push ROTARY SELECTOR to choose SKIP, I'LL ADD IT ON MY COMPUTER
  1. What's this about? Push one of the five topics, or NOT SURE.
  2. What happened? Type a few words, or push SKIP, I'LL ADD IT ON MY COMPUTER.
  3. Ready to send. Check the summary, then push SEND REPORT.

With the encoder, push three times: the first topic, SKIP, then SEND.

Once you type, NEXT is lit instead.

BACK goes back a step. If you leave the page before sending, your words wait for you there.

After you send

The report goes one of three ways. Whichever it is, nothing is lost and you never type it again.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap EXTRAS
    3. Tap REPORT AN ISSUE
    4. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR to SOMETHING ISN'T WORKING and push it
    5. Type test report on the screen keyboard
    6. Tap NEXT
    7. Tap SEND REPORT
    8. Tap EDIT REPORT
    9. Tap CHANGE
    10. Tap HOW DO I...?
    11. Tap NEXT
    12. Tap SEND REPORT
    13. Tap DONE
The screen saysWhat happenedWhat to do
SENT and a reference like R-4F7K-2M9QIt reached the XZ Mods inboxFinish it on your computer: the XZ Mods app reminds you and shows the same reference
SAVED ON THIS STICKThe player is offline, its clock is not set, the loader is from an older XZ Mods app, or the inbox did not take itPlug the stick into your computer. The XZ Mods app opens the report
NOT SENT YETIt could not be sent, and the stick could not take itDo what the line says (put the stick back, use a writable stick, make room on it), then push TRY AGAIN

A saved report waits in VJ.Tools/XZ-Mods-reports/pending/ on the stick, up to 32 of them. The XZ Mods app sends it from there and moves it to sent/. TRY AGAIN sends the same report, so the maintainer gets it once.

Report an error from the dock

When an error shows in the dock's top row, REPORT THIS beside it opens REPORT AN ISSUE at WHAT HAPPENED? with SOMETHING ISN'T WORKING chosen. Push SKIP and SEND REPORT, and the error goes with it. Every report includes an error on screen, however you open it.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap REPORT THIS
    3. Tap SKIP, I'LL ADD IT ON MY COMPUTER
    4. Tap SEND REPORT

What the player sends

The report holds facts the player can check, never text read from its screens:

  • the topic and your words, if any;
  • the XZ Mods version and a fingerprint of your settings, with a few of them (stems, gate cue, interface, theme, deck view, browse preview);
  • the loader ID from ABOUT and the ID of the computer that made the loader, so the report reaches your own XZ Mods app;
  • the screen MODS was opened from (PLAY, BROWSE and so on), the interface, the deck view and the code of any error on screen;
  • known status codes from the four-deck bridge and the player, and the recent entries of the USB diary on this stick.

It never holds music, track or playlist names, file names or network addresses. Only the maintainer reads it. You can also report from the XZ Mods app. See Messages and troubleshooting.

About XZ Mods

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap EXTRAS
    3. Tap ABOUT XZ MODS
    4. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 2 clicks clockwise

Turn the encoder to a link, then push or tap it to show it as a QR code. Scan the code for CREDITS / NOTICES to read the full credits, licences and matching source. Support is voluntary. Every feature stays available without it.

four-decks.title: Four decks
four-decks.html:
Four decks adds two software players, DECK 3 and DECK 4, to the XDJ-XZ's own DECK 1 and DECK 2. You hear them on mixer channels CH3 and CH4. A short USB cable from the back of the player to a top USB port carries their sound into the mixer: it leaves through a top USB port and comes back in at the rear USB socket, where a computer with DJ software would connect. The physical controls switch between decks with the same presses DJ software uses on the XDJ-XZ.

  1. Decks 3 and 4 Decks 3 and 4 are software players. They run inside the player, beside decks 1 and 2.
  2. Top USB Their sound leaves the player through the top USB port the cable is in, USB 1 or USB 2.
  3. Loopback cable The loopback cable carries it over the back edge of the player.
  4. Rear USB It comes back in at the rear USB socket, where a computer with DJ software would connect.
  5. CH3 and CH4 With their input switches on USB, mixer channels CH3 and CH4 play decks 3 and 4.
Experimental

Four decks is experimental in this version. Test it with your own tracks before a set, keep the music stick connected, and keep a two-deck plan ready.

What you need experimental

  • The loopback cable: a USB cable with a USB-B plug on one end and a USB-A plug on the other, the kind a printer uses.
  • For tracks, a music stick in the other top USB port, or music sticks on one USB 2.0 hub in that port. Decks 3 and 4 can start before you insert any music.
  • Decks 1 and 2 stopped or paused while decks 3 and 4 start. Once they run, you can play all four decks.
  • CH3 and CH4 on the mixer set to USB so you hear decks 3 and 4.

The cable goes directly from the rear USB socket to either USB 1 or USB 2 on top. Put music in the other top port. The picture uses USB 1 as an example; both arrangements work.

  1. One USB-B to USB-A cable runs from the rear USB socket over the back edge into a top USB port; the picture shows USB 1. No computer is involved.

Set up four decks experimental

    1. Tap DECKS
    2. Turn ROTARY SELECTOR 1 click clockwise, then push it
    3. Tap RESCAN
  1. Stop or pause decks 1 and 2.
  2. Choose either top USB port for the loopback cable. Leave the other port for music.
  3. Plug the USB-B end of the loopback cable into the rear USB socket.
  4. Plug the USB-A end directly into your chosen top port, USB 1 or USB 2.
  5. Set the CH3 and CH4 input switches to USB.
  6. Tap DECKS at the top of the play screen and choose one of the 4 DECKS pictures, or open MODS and choose 4 DECKS.
  7. Wait for DECKS 3 AND 4 ARE READY. The card in the lanes of decks 3 and 4 tells you each step it is waiting for.
  8. Press SHIFT twice on the left side to play deck 3, or on the right side to play deck 4.

Decks 3 and 4 start as soon as the cable is in, even when decks 1 and 2 have no tracks loaded. You can leave the cable connected before starting the USB loader. No RESCAN is needed. Decks 1 and 2 must be stopped or paused while the route starts. RESCAN checks at once if you want to check again. After a disconnection, plug the cable back into either top port. Decks 3 and 4 come back once decks 1 and 2 are stopped or paused; the card says when it is waiting for that. No restart of the USB loader is needed, also when you move the cable to the other port.

Note

The XZ Mods app shows steps 2 to 5 with an animation of the cable while it writes your USB and when it is done. You set four decks up at the player, not in the app.

Tip

You can choose a four-deck view before you plug in the cable. Decks 3 and 4 then show a card with the cable steps and their current state, and decks 1 and 2 keep playing as usual.

Add music and a USB hub experimental

Once the USB loader is running, you can bring up decks 3 and 4 with only the loopback cable connected. Insert music later in the other top port. Starting the audio route does not load a track.

To connect several music sticks, put one high-speed USB 2.0 hub in the top port opposite the loopback cable. Stop or pause decks 1 and 2 while a newly connected hub starts. Connect the sticks to that hub and choose the sources the player makes available. The hub does not add more decks or source buttons.

Connect the loopback cable directly to the player, never through the music hub. Do not connect a second hub behind the first. Check that your hub and drives have enough power; use the hub's own power supply if it has one. Keep any drive that holds a playing track connected.

The 4 DECKS page in MODS

MODS > 4 DECKS shows the cable's state, lets you choose the deck view, and lists what works on each deck.

    1. Press MENU
    2. Tap 4 DECKS
    3. Tap 4 DECKS
    4. Tap 4 DECKS
    5. Tap 2 DECKS

The HOME page shows the same state on the 4 DECKS card. When four decks need you (no cable found, a failed start, a lost connection, or no four-deck engine on the USB loader) HOME also shows SET UP FOUR DECKS, which opens this page.

If the USB loader has no four-deck engine, the page says so and offers CHECK INSTALLED ENGINE. Rebuild the USB loader in the XZ Mods app, restart the player with it, then press CHECK INSTALLED ENGINE.

HOME status lineWhat it means
Not connectedNo loopback cable found yet.
Looking for the cableA check is running now.
Starting decks 3 and 4The cable is found and the software players are starting, or they wait for decks 1 and 2 to stop.
Ready, 2 decks shownDecks 3 and 4 run. The play screen shows two decks.
Ready, 4 decks shownDecks 3 and 4 run. The play screen shows four decks.
Could not startThe start failed. The 4 DECKS page says why.
DisconnectedThe cable was unplugged or lost power.
Not available on this playerThe software players are not running in this build.

The card in every state
